# dsh-web-search-duck

Web search provider for the DSH `ctx.web` seam. It bridges any OpenAI **Responses-API-compatible** endpoint that supports the `web_search_preview` tool: the query is sent to the endpoint, and `url_citation` annotations in the response are mapped to a concise answer plus deduplicated sources.

Registers search provider id `duck-responses-search`.

## Configuration

| env | meaning | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DUCK_SEARCH_ENDPOINT` | Responses API endpoint URL | **required** |
| `DUCK_SEARCH_MODEL` | model name sent in the request | **required** |
| `DUCK_SEARCH_CREDENTIAL` | DSH credentials-store key used for `Authorization: Bearer` | `DSH_WEB_SEARCH_TOKEN` |

Without endpoint/model configured the provider throws a clear error instead of guessing.

## Enable

Point the web seam at this provider in your host patch:

```yaml
- id: web
  override:
    searchProvider: duck-responses-search
```

## Install

Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.

## License

MIT

# dsh-media-gen [English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) Generate images and videos in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using the OpenRouter provider and API key already configured in DSH. **Only OpenRouter is supported.** ## Features - Ask the agent to write a model-specific prompt, or send your prompt unchanged through a generation card or command. - Choose models per conversation, use input images, and reuse generated images for image or video generation. - Save results in the working directory (`generated-media/` by default). Video jobs run in the background and notify their originating session. - English and Japanese UI; command responses are English. ## Compatibility Choose a release for your DSH version from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen/releases). Supported versions and changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## Installation Replace `` with the full release tag you selected: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen.git#' ``` The repository includes built files, so no local build is needed. It is private: your git must be authenticated with a GitHub account that has access. Replace `web` if you use another profile. To update, run the same `add` command with the new tag and restart DSH. Omitting the tag installs the latest `main`, including unreleased changes; always specify a tag when reinstalling a particular release. To remove: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-media-gen ``` Restart DSH after removal. In DSH's Models settings, add an OpenRouter provider and save its API key. ## Usage

*From a chat request to a generated image, ready to reuse in another image or video. Presentation edited from a user-provided screenshot; the displayed cost is specific to this example.* ### Generation cards and chat Open **Generate…** beside the chat input and choose image/video, model, prompt, and available generation options. - **Ask the agent** lets the agent write or translate your prompt and ask about missing details. - **Generate as written** sends your text unchanged and starts a billable request. Check the displayed estimate first. You can also ask directly in chat. For different image variants, ask for one prompt per image; `/image --count` instead repeats the same prompt. Generated images open in DSH's file preview. **Use for image** and **Use for video** open a card using the image as input (the first frame for video). **Use in chat** inserts its path and replaces the current draft. Ask the agent to save model-specific prompt notes if needed. Notes persist across restarts and apply to all conversations; saving or clearing them always requires approval. ### Commands Place options before the prompt and quote paths containing spaces with `"`. | Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `/image [--model id] [--aspect 1:1] [--resolution 1K] [--count n] [--seed n] [--image path]... [--yes] ` | Generate images; repeat `--image` for multiple inputs | | `/video [--model id] [--duration seconds] [--aspect 16:9] [--resolution 720p] [--audio on\|off] [--seed n] [--first path] [--last path] [--ref path]... [--yes] ` | Submit a video job with optional first/last frames and reference images | | `/media-jobs [job-id]` | List this session's video jobs or check one immediately | | `/media-model` | Show selected models and defaults | | `/media-model image` | List image model IDs | | `/media-model image [provider]` | Select a model for this conversation | | `/media-model image default` | Clear the conversation selection | | `/media-approval on` | Allow generation in this conversation without normal per-request confirmation | | `/media-approval off` | Restore normal per-request confirmation | Use `video` instead of `image` for video model selection. Chat-input selectors do the same thing; selections persist across restarts. The agent prioritizes the conversation selection over its own model argument, then uses configured defaults when no model is specified. Choosing a different card model through **Ask the agent** updates an existing conversation selection. ### Approval and costs Generation costs money. With `requireApproval` enabled and no conversation permission, agent requests ask for approval with the actual prompt and estimated cost; direct commands show only an estimate unless you add `--yes`. The chat input's **Media → Ask before generating** menu also controls conversation permission; only the user can change it. Agent tools always ask before sending images outside the working directory or making a second generation call in the same turn, even if normal confirmation is disabled. Direct commands follow `requireApproval`, `--yes`, and conversation permission instead; these extra agent checks do not apply to them. Estimates may be unknown or lower than the actual bill, especially for input-image or token charges. Required agent approvals still ask when an estimate cannot be obtained. After a timeout or unusable response, the provider may already have charged: check before retrying. If part of a multi-image request fails, already saved images are returned with the failure. ### Video jobs Jobs resume tracking after a DSH restart when storage is available. Completed files are downloaded automatically; completion, failure, or expiry is reported to the session when it is open. Jobs started with `/video` do not wake the agent on completion; use `/media-jobs` or wait for the next agent turn. After `videoMaxWatchMs` (3 hours by default), tracking stops. This does **not** cancel the provider job or guarantee a refund. Ask the agent to check the job with `media_video_status` and its `job_id` to resume tracking. ## Configuration Open **Plugins → Media Generation → Components → Media Generation >** for model defaults, chat-menu models, limits, approval, and notifications. **All models…** can select a model outside your chat-menu filter; the agent can still list all models. | Setting | Default | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `defaultImageProvider` / `defaultImageModel` | unset | Default image provider/model IDs | | `defaultVideoProvider` / `defaultVideoModel` | unset | Default video provider/model IDs | | `chatImageModels` / `chatVideoModels` | `[]` | Chat-menu model IDs; empty shows all | | `maxImagesPerCall` | 4 | Images per call | | `maxVideoSeconds` | 10 | Video duration limit; see Limitations | | `requireApproval` | true | Normal per-generation confirmation | | `outputDir` | `generated-media` | Relative output path within the working directory | | `notifyOnVideoCompletion` | true | Notify the session when a video job ends | For polling, tracking, timeout, cache, and download-size settings, see the [configuration schema](src/index.ts). ## Limitations - Input images are sent to OpenRouter. Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF up to 20 MiB are accepted, and the model must support the requested input images or frames. API keys are not sent to the browser. - Avoid common output-folder names such as `Pictures`. To display older outputs, the image route also accepts images in matching output folders without distinguishing working directories. - Video previews support mp4, m4v, webm, and mov up to 32 MiB, independently of the download limit. - When duration is omitted, `maxVideoSeconds` can limit the model's default only if its catalog lists supported durations. - Without DSH storage, video tracking does not survive restarts. ## Development After cloning: ```sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm check ``` `pnpm check` runs type checks, the build, tests, and CHANGELOG validation. To load the local checkout: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add ``` After editing `src/`, run `pnpm build` and commit the generated `lib/` files with the source changes. Update both READMEs whe

plugins.readme_text:
# Reply Suggestions

**简体中文** · [English](./README_EN.md)

根据上一轮对话，自动推荐下一句提问。回车填入，编辑后再发送。

一个为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供输入框推荐的插件。助手回答结束后，输入框为空时显示灰色推荐；按回车将它变成可编辑的草稿，不会自动发送。

| 项目 | 当前版本 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件 | `0.1.16` |
| 已核对的官方桌面版 | `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| 许可证 | [MIT](./LICENSE) |

## 功能

- 根据最近一次用户问题和助手回答，生成一条相关的后续提问。
- 第一次按 **Enter** 把推荐填入草稿，可继续编辑；之后按 Harness 原有规则发送。
- 按 **Escape** 隐藏当前推荐。
- 保留中文输入法确认和 Shift/Ctrl/Command/Alt+Enter 的原有行为。
- 输入框有草稿、附件、引用或待处理队列时延后生成；任务运行时不显示推荐。
- 使用 Harness 已配置的模型和凭据，不需要另填 API Key。
- 在插件详情页查看历史总量、今天、昨天、近 7 天和近 30 天的推荐 Token 用量及人民币费用估算。
- 在详情页点击“更新价格”，或默认每 7 天自动检查官方价格表。

## 演示

![灰色推荐与按 Enter 填入草稿](./assets/reply-suggestions-demo-0.1.16.png)

演示由真实 0.1.16 客户端的测试夹具输出生成，并置于模拟对话页面；非 DSH 桌面实录。对话和推荐为演示数据，没有调用模型。

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装

1. 打开 DSH 的 **插件** 页面，先检查是否已安装 `dsh-reply-suggestions`。已安装时使用更新入口，避免重复添加。
2. 确认官方桌面版为 `0.2.0-rc.2`。
3. 点击 **添加插件**，在“包名或地址”中填写：

   ```text
   https://github.com/jabingu/dsh-reply-suggestions
   ```

4. 按应用提示完成加载并启用，重启 DSH。
5. 完成一次普通对话，保持输入框为空，等待灰色推荐出现。

仓库包含构建好的 `lib/`，安装前无需自行构建。DSH peer 版本锁定为 `0.2.0-rc.2`；其他版本需要先核对接口。

### 从本地目录安装

下载仓库 ZIP 并解压，或克隆仓库。检查插件尚未安装后，在同一添加入口填写包含 `package.json` 的目录绝对路径，启用后重启 DSH。

官方桌面 profile 由应用管理，请使用桌面插件页面。确实使用 `dsh web` 的用户可在插件目录执行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web list --depth=0
# 确认尚未安装后再添加：
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

更新本地链接安装时，更新已链接目录中的文件并重启 DSH 即可，无需重复安装。

## 使用示例

发送：

> 请用两三句话解释什么是插件，并举一个生活中的类比。不要调用工具或创建文件。

回答完成后，可能出现“能给我一个最简单的插件示例吗？”的灰色推荐。按一次 Enter 填入，修改后再发送。具体内容由模型生成，随对话变化。

## 模型与 token 消耗

每次生成推荐会额外调用一次模型，即使没有采用推荐，也已产生该次请求的用量。默认沿用助手回答记录的 provider/model；rc.2 记录缺少元数据时，使用会话当前模型投影。

插件通过以下方式限制开销：

- 只读取上一轮正文，不传整段历史、推理块或附件内容。
- 用户问题最多 **400 个字符**，助手回答最多 **1,200 个字符**；客户端和 Host 均执行限制。
- 长文本保留约前三分之一和后三分之二，中段标记省略；Markdown 围栏代码块在本地省略，保留周围说明及行内代码。
- 使用较短提示词，输出上限为 **96 token**；此上限不包含输入 token。
- DeepSeek 的推荐请求关闭深度思考，不改变主对话的推理设置。
- 输入框可用且空闲 **800 毫秒**后才请求；等待期间开始输入会取消定时器。
- 已发起请求后输入文字会暂时隐藏推荐，结果可在清空草稿后复用，避免取消重试。切换会话、开始新一轮或卸载仍取消旧请求。
- Host 最多缓存 64 条已完成结果，最多同时生成两条推荐。

相比旧版，上下文上限从 14,000 降到 1,600 字符，减少约 88.6%；这不是每次实际 token 的节省比例。压缩可能让推荐忽略回答中段和代码细节。插件不额外调用模型进行摘要。

## 用量统计

打开 **插件 → Reply Suggestions**，可查看历史总量及四个时间范围的已记录 Token、输入（含模型缓存）/输出 Token、请求次数，以及未返回用量、失败和取消的请求次数。

“历史总量”汇总开始记录以来的全部有效请求，包括超过 30 天的记录；直接按请求去重汇总，不把四个重叠时间范围相加。费用按每次请求保存的价格估算，缺少用量或价格时标明未知/部分；开始记录前没有保存的历史无法补回。

统计精简为两张卡片：左侧默认显示今天，可通过下拉菜单切换昨天、近 7 天或近 30 天；右侧固定显示历史总量。切换直接使用已读取的数据，不增加模型或统计请求。

Token 数量自动显示 K（千）、M（百万），最多保留两位小数，例如 `12K`、`1.23M`；不足一千显示整数。总量与输入/输出均采用此格式，实际记录和费用计算仍使用完整 Token 数。

- 使用 DSH 模型流返回的实际 `usage`，不把字符估算当成真实 Token。
- 近 7 天、近 30 天包含今天，按 DSH Host 的本机时区和自然日汇总。
- 只记录本插件生成推荐的请求，不统计主对话、其他插件或查看统计的 RPC。
- 本插件复用已生成推荐时没有新模型请求，不重复计数；提供方报告的缓存 Token 仍包含在输入统计内。
- 一次请求收到多条累计用量，只保存最后一条有效用量，不累加重复快照。失败/取消时已返回的用量也计入；未返回用量则标注为“未知”，不假定为零。
- 数据在重启后保留，记录开始时间也会显示。升级前没有记录的历史无法补回。
- 页面打开时每 15 秒刷新，也可手动点击“刷新”；刷新不会调用模型。

记录保存在 Harness 数据目录的 `storages/dsh-reply-suggestions/usage.jsonl`，遵循 `DSH_HOME`，默认位于 `~/.dsh`。不同 profile 使用同一数据目录时共享本插件的统计。文件保存记录编号、时间、请求状态、Token 数；从 0.1.8 起还保存实际请求的 provider/model 和价格版本，不保存对话正文、附件或凭据。无法保存或读取记录时，页面会标明统计可能不完整。

### 费用估算

每张卡片显示人民币 API 公开价估算，范围为空闲价～高峰价。读取用量仅使用本地价格；更新价格时直接读取官方网页，不调用模型。以下为插件内置的 [DeepSeek 官方价格](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)，核对日期 2026-10-14，单位为元/百万 Token；联网成功后新请求使用获取到的价格：

| 模型 | 输入未命中（空闲/高峰） | 输入缓存命中（空闲/高峰） | 输出（空闲/高峰） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Flash | 1 / 2 | 0.02 / 0.04 | 4 / 8 |
| Pro | 4.5 / 9 | 0.15 / 0.30 | 13.5 / 27 |

费用 =（输入减缓存命中）×输入单价 + 缓存命中×缓存单价 + 输出×输出单价，再除以一百万。范围不推测中国法定节假日，不代表实际账单、赠送额度或套餐扣费。

- 官方 `deepseek` / `deepseek-account` 的 Flash、Pro 使用各自价格；Flash 的官方兼容名称使用 Flash 价。其他 provider/model 不套用此价格，标记为未计入费用。
- 0.1.6/0.1.7 的记录缺少模型名称，保留原记录，并明确标注“历史请求按 Flash 假设估算”。如果当时使用其他模型，此部分金额不适用。
- 未返回用量、价格未知或记录早于对应价格生效日的请求不估算，不当成免费；部分可计算时显示“部分”。费用范围按每条记录计算后汇总。
- 新请求在生成推荐前保存完整价格快照，即使生成期间调价，仍按开始请求时的价格估算。更新不会重新计算旧请求的价格；0.1.8 的旧价格版本继续保留。
- 微小费用保留最多六位小数，低于 ¥0.000001 的非零费用仍显示“小于 ¥0.000001”。

### 更新价格

在 **插件 → Reply Suggestions → 推荐 Token 用量** 下方点击 **更新价格**，立即检查官方人民币价格表。它与“刷新”按钮独立：刷新只读取用量，更新价格才会访问网页。页面显示上次成功检查、下次检查及失败原因。

在“自动更新周期”下拉框选择 **每天、每 3 天、每周（7 天）、每 30 天、仅手动更新**。选择后自动保存并生效，重启后保留。保存失败时保留原周期；选择“仅手动更新”仍可点击“更新价格”。

- 默认每 7 天检查；Host 每小时判断是否到期。首次启动或到期后重启会立即补检查，DSH 关闭期间不运行。
- 自动更新失败后等 24 小时再重试，手动按钮随时可重试；同一 Host 中同时触发的更新共用一次请求。
- 仅访问官方价格页的规范地址 `https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/`，15 秒超时，不使用 API 密钥、不发送对话、不跟随跳转。
- 严格解析 Flash/Pro、人民币、每百万 Token、输入未命中/缓存命中/输出及空闲/高峰价格。网络不可用、币种/单位不符、字段缺失或页面结构变化时保留已有价格，并提示失败。
- 缓存及检查结果追加保存到 Harness 数据目录的 `storages/dsh-reply-suggestions/prices.jsonl`；重启后恢复，避免重复检查。价格无法落盘时会提示当前价格可能仅在本次运行有效。
- 未在详情页选择过周期时，使用配置中的 `autoUpdatePrices` / `priceUpdateDays`（默认每 7 天，允许 1～30 天）。详情页保存的选择优先于这些初始配置，随 `prices.jsonl` 恢复；共享同一数据目录的 profile 也共享这项选择。

## 可选配置

一般无需配置。如需指定其他已在 Harness 配置好的模型，可在使用中的 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖：

```yaml
- id: reply-suggestions
  config:
    enabled: true
    timeoutMs: 20000
    autoUpdatePrices: true
    priceUpdateDays: 7
    provider: your-configured-provider
    model: your-configured-model
```

| 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 是否生成推荐 |
| `timeoutMs` | `20000` | 超时毫秒数，允许 1,000～60,000 |
| `provider` | 跟随对话 | 可选，必须是已配置的提供方 |
| `model` | 跟随对话 | 可选，必须是该提供方可用的模型 |
| `autoUpdatePrices` | `true` | 自动检查价格；设为 `false` 时仍可手动更新 |
| `priceUpdateDays` | `7` | 自动检查周期，1～30 天；失败后 24 小时重试 |

失败、超时或输出不符合要求时，输入框保留普通行为。可在客户端控制台查找 `[reply-suggestions]` 诊断。

## 开发

开发要求 Node.js 22 或更高版本。已在 Windows x64 的 Node 22.23.3 和 24.16.0 上实际验证，无需安装构建依赖：

```powershell
npm run build
npm test
```

`npm test` 自动枚举测试文件，避免 Node 22 和 Windows 下通配符展开的差异；可使用 `npm test -- --test-reporter=dot` 显示简洁结果。

[Node compatibility](./.github/workflows/test.yml) 工作流在 push、pull request 和手动触发时，分别在 Windows、Linux 上测试 Node 22 和 24。每个任务执行构建、构建产物一致性检查、全部测试、客户端语法检查及 `npm pack`。工作流随代码推送到 GitHub 后生效；本地验证不代表云端任务已经运行。

桌面插件使用 DSH 内置运行环境，以上 Node 测试不替代桌面视觉和输入法验收。

```text
src/common.mjs       RPC 契约、上下文压缩、键盘保护
src/engine.mjs       模型请求、预算、缓存与超时
src/usage.mjs        持久化用量记录和自然日汇总
src/pricing.mjs      官方人民币价格版本及费用范围计算
src/price-updates.mjs 官方网页解析、定期检查与价格缓存
src/index.mjs        Host 服务注册
src/client.cjs       灰色推荐、生成时机、草稿填入
lib/                 已构建的 Host 和客户端文件
locale/              插件名称和中英文介绍
scripts/build.mjs    无额外构建依赖的打包脚本
scripts/test.mjs     跨平台测试文件枚举及运行脚本
.github/workflows/test.yml Node 22/24 的 Windows/Linux 自动测试
tests/               行为和客户端生命周期测试
```

实现使用官方 Typert/Gateway RPC、`llm.stream`、`conversation.input.overlay` 槽位、会话快照和草稿动作。布局定位依赖 rc.2 的 composer DOM 标记，版本变更时需要重新检查。

## 验证范围

- Node 22.23.3 和 24.16.0 分别通过 66 项自动化测试，覆盖推荐交互、占位节点生命周期、用量及历史总量去重、日期边界、费用计算、价格更新及周期保存、失败回退、重启恢复和统计页面卸载。验证日期：2026-10-14。
- `0.1.16` 修复并发相同请求重复调用模型、输入框重复挂载产生重叠推荐，以及损坏价格缓存警告被错误清除的问题。两个 Node 版本均通过真实 rc.2 库的 RPC、缓存计数及重启恢复检查，模型使用 stub；桌面视觉验收仍需单独完成。
- 使用官方 rc.2 安装包中的 Cordis、Typert 和 Host/Client Gateway，验证了实际插件 fiber 的挂载、RPC 和卸载，模型使用 stub。
- `0.1.2` 曾在真实 rc.2 桌面端验证推荐生成、显示、首次 Enter 填入、编辑、Shift+Enter 换行、发送、Escape 和会话切换。
- `0.1.3` 的用量优化及 `0.1.4` 的展示元数据更新已通过自动化和资源检查；没有重新进行真实模型质量或桌面视觉验收。
- `0.1.5` 增加透明 PNG 对话图标，已核对尺寸、透明通道、256 KB 限制和打包清单；未改动推荐或快捷键逻辑。
- `0.1.6` 已用官方 rc.2 Cordis、Typert、Gateway 和 SlotCore 检查用量 RPC、详情页注册及缓存计数；真实桌面详情页显示四个统计卡片，并核对了一条实际推荐的 223 Token 与本地记录一致。刷新统计未增加模型请求。
- `0.1.7` 将占位文字隐藏样式移入输入框组件，并用内联样式隐藏辅助提示，修复返回旧对话时提示文字与占位文字重叠。
- `0.1.8` 加入人民币费用范围估算，真实历史 911 Token（输入 844、输出 67）按 Flash 假设得到 ¥0.001112～¥0.002224；官方 rc.2 RPC 检查和统计组件测试通过，尚未重新进行本版本的桌面视觉验收。
- `0.1.9` 加入手动/周期更新：真实访问官方页面、价格保存及重新加载成功；真实 rc.2 Gateway 验证更新按钮对应 RPC，统计与价格检查不增加模型调用。未重新进行桌面视觉验收。
- `0.1.10` 将总量及输入/输出 Token 自动缩写为 K/M，最多两位小数。
- `0.1.11` 在详情页增加自动更新周期选择；真实 rc.2 RPC 验证保存及 Host 重启恢复，失败保持旧设置。未重新进行桌面视觉验收。
- `0.1.12` 直接隐藏实际占位节点并观察重建，组件之间共用隐藏租约，避免旧实例卸载恢复新实例仍需隐藏的占位文字。已实际验证重启、插件页返回及历史对话切换，观察到单条推荐且无占位文字重叠。
- `0.1.13` 加入历史总量卡片，汇总全部有效记录并沿用 K/M 显示及历史价格。超过 30 天、重复、未知、异常和未来记录测试通过；真实 rc.2 RPC 与 Host 重启恢复验证通过。未重新进行本版本桌面视觉验收。

其他 Harness 版本、第三方桌面壳和真人输入法选词需要另行实测。模型生成的推荐可以修改或忽略。

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH plugin: let an Agent Teams Lead choose the provider, model, and reasoning effort of each teammate it spawns.
plugins.readme_text:
# Team Model Routing (`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`)

Let an Agent Teams **Lead** choose the `provider`, `model`, and
`reasoning_effort` of each teammate it spawns, validated against the Subagent
model-selection allowlist.

## Why it needs a plugin

`spawn_teammate` (shipped) carries no route fields, and
`ctx.agentTeams.spawnTeammate()` forwards only a provider *name* to
`ctx.subagents.startContinuable()`, which is where `agentOptions` live.

A teammate is a **continuable** child: the continuation registry materializes it
through `ctx.agents.create()` and **never calls a subagent provider's
`start()`**. So wrapping a subagent provider (the obvious first idea) can never
route a teammate — the wrapper is simply never asked to start it, and the
teammate silently ends up on the inherited route.

## The seam that works

```
spawn_teammate_routed            record route by (Lead, teammate name, context)
        ↓
agentTeams.spawnTeammate(...)    shipped Team service, unchanged contract
        ↓
ctx.agents.create()              child materialized; initial prompt queued to inbox
        ↓
agent/pre-step (child scope)     ← plugin: claim route, rewrite child.options
        ↓
AgentLoop.prepareRequest()       reads this.options → request/header + assistant
                                 message source + every later step
```

Two facts make this work, both verified in the installed sources:

- `agent/pre-step` is an awaited waterfall that runs **before** `step()` →
  `prepareRequest()` (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:902-925 → 978 → 1050`).
- `prepareRequest()` reads `this.options` on **every** step
  (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1168-1173`), and the loop and the Agent object
  share one `options` reference (`:774`, `:1739`).

The order matters in the other direction too: the child's initial prompt is
submitted *after* creation and the loop appends it to the transcript only
*inside* that first step, so the teammate name must be read from the step's
claimed messages (`payload.messages`), with the transcript as a fallback for a
resumed teammate. Reading the session snapshot at `agent/created` time finds
nothing — that was the first implementation's fatal flaw.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `spawn_teammate_routed` | Same contract as `spawn_teammate`, plus `provider` / `model` / `reasoning_effort`. Omit all three to inherit the Lead route. |
| `list_teammate_models` | Lists selectable providers, then selectable models for one provider, then that model's reasoning efforts. |

Both are installed in the **Lead's own Agent scope** (never globally), so
teammates do not see them.

## Allowlist

When `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings` is
`enabled: true`, explicit routes outside `allowedModels` are rejected **before**
the teammate is created. Pure inheritance is never restricted. An enabled but
empty allowlist makes every route unselectable rather than failing inheritance.

The route is also validated through `llm.resolveCallConfig()`, so an unknown
model or an unsupported reasoning effort fails with the adapter's own message
instead of surfacing later as a failed turn.

## Config

```yaml
- id: team-model-routing
  name: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing'
  config:
    toolName: spawn_teammate_routed
    listToolName: list_teammate_models
    freshProvider: spawn
    forkProvider: fork
    routeTtlMs: 120000
```

`freshProvider` / `forkProvider` are the provider names handed to the shipped
Team service; they must name registered subagent providers (`spawn`, `fork`).

## Known limits

- **The route is process-local.** It lives in the plugin's memory, so it applies
  while the child is created in this process. A teammate cold-resumed after a
  Harness **restart** falls back to the `agentOptions` recorded in its
  `subagent/descriptor`. Making that survive a restart needs a durable record and
  is the natural follow-up.
- **`agent.options` is a runtime object**, not part of the public `Agent`
  interface. The rewrite is the reason this stays a plugin rather than a
  one-line change; upstream, the clean fix is to let the provider contribute
  `agentOptions` through `ContinuableCreateSpec` (or to accept `agentOptions` on
  the team spawn request). The upstream repository does not accept external PRs
  — publish this as a `dsh-plugin`, and raise the API gap in Discussions.
- A recorded route that is never claimed (a spawn that failed before the child
  existed) expires after `routeTtlMs` and is harmless.

## Test

```sh
node packages/team-model-routing/test/logic.test.mjs
```

18 checks over route validation, allowlist enforcement, discovery rendering, the
claim store, and teammate-name extraction. It covers `logic.js` only — the
`agent/pre-step` seam itself needs a live run.

## Install

Published as [`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing)
on npm, source at [Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing](https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing).

```sh
npm install dsh-plugin-team-model-routing
```

or point the plugin manager at the installed package or a workspace directory:

```js
plugin_manager({ action: 'install_bundle', target: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing' })
```

Installing loads the module once; because Node caches ES modules by resolved
path, **replacing this package's code requires a Harness restart** to take
effect in a running process.

## Repository layout

```
index.js            Cordis Host plugin: tools, routing hook, Provider wiring
logic.js            dependency-free routing/claim logic (unit-tested)
cordis.patch.yml    Loader patch: this row + the tool-agent-team config
locale/{en,zh}.json Plugin Manager display metadata
test/logic.test.mjs the 18-check logic suite (not shipped in the npm tarball)
```

`npm pack` ships `index.js`, `logic.js`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `icon.svg`,
`locale/*.json`, `LICENSE`, and both READMEs.


## Verified live

Observed on the `desktop` profile, 2026-10-15, with the profile's
`subagentModelSelection` allowlist enabled:

| Check | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Route reaches the child | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'model-server', model: 'glm-5.3', reasoning_effort: 'high' })` → host log `team-model-routing: teammate "confirm-route" now runs on model-server/glm-5.3 (effort high)`, and `list_agents` reported that teammate as `model: "glm-5.3"` while the Lead was `gpt-6.1-sol` and the profile default is `bosc/deepseek-flash`. |
| `list_agents` reads the applied route | `list_agents` shows the rewritten `model` for the routed teammate, and `gpt-6.1-sol` (the inherited route) for teammates created before this plugin existed. |
| Allowlist rejects before creation | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'bosc', model: 'gpt-5.6-luna' })` → `Error: teammate LLM route "bosc/gpt-5.6-luna" is not allowed by the Subagent model-selection allowlist; allowed: model-server/glm-5.3, kimi-code/k3, bosc/gpt-5.6-sol, model-server/kimi-k3, bosc/deepseek-flash` — no teammate was created. |
| Both tools are live in the Lead scope | `Tool.listTools` lists `spawn_teammate_routed` (with `provider`/`model`/`reasoning_effort`) and `list_teammate_models`. |

Not covered by the live run: the `fork` context, and route survival across a
teammate cold-resume (see Known limits).

## Releasing a new version

The package is `dsh-plugin` shaped: `dsh.bundle.patch` points at
`cordis.patch.yml`, the manifest carries display `meta`, `icon.svg`, `locale/{en,zh}.json`,
and it is `type: module`. To release:

1. Bump `version` in `package.json` (npm rejects a re-publish of an existing version).
2. `node test/logic.test.mjs` — 18 checks must pass.
3. `npm pack --dry-run` — confirm the tarball is the 10 files listed under
   [Repository layout](#repository-layout).
4. `npm publish` — the npm account has 2FA enabled, so pass `--otp=<code>` or use a
   granular token with **bypass 2FA** enabled. When a code is needed, ask for one
   interactively rather than storing it.
5. `git commit` and `git push` the release.
6. If the package name ever changes, update the `name:` line in `cordis.patch.yml`
   to match — the Loader resolves the row by that string.

## Inviting t

plugins.description: dsh plugin that syncs pi.dev model listings into the pi-ai catalog and llm-pi-ai settings — new provider models become selectable without hand-editing node_modules.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pi-ai-sync

A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Cordis plugin that keeps
provider routes in step with the pi.dev gateway by maintaining **both** layers a
model has to pass through:

- the **pi-ai catalog** (`@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/providers/data/<route>.json`)
  — the "does dsh know this model and which protocol does it speak?" layer, and
- the **settings model list** (`llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models`) — the
  "does the model picker offer it?" layer.

It is the fusion of
[`dsh-model-sync`](https://github.com/fan56/dsh-model-sync) (settings seam) and
[`dsh-opencode-go-models`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-go-models)
(pi-ai catalog file), with no hand-maintained protocol/family tables: pi.dev's
listing already carries every record in pi-ai catalog shape.

## Why

dsh resolves a configured model's wire protocol as
`route.api ?? catalog[id].api ?? sharedCatalogApi(route)`. On the dsh 0.1.x line
the settings model schema has **no per-model `api` field**, so:

- routes with a single protocol are fine — the route-level api fills the gap;
- a **mixed-protocol** route (`opencode`: anthropic-messages +
  openai-completions + openai-responses + google-generative-ai) has no shared
  api, so any model missing from the installed catalog is rejected outright:
  hand-adding it errors, and a settings-only sync has to drop it.

`dsh-pi-ai-sync` fixes the root cause instead of working around it: it copies
the missing records into the installed catalog, then lets the (now complete)
catalog serve the route.

## How it works

```
one round, per managed route
  1. GET https://pi.dev/api/models/providers/<route>     (catalog-shaped records)
  2. catalog layer  → copy records the installed catalog is missing into
                       dist/providers/data/<route>.json
                       (atomic write + first-modification backup)
                       ⇒ the model becomes base-matching; restart needed
  3. settings layer → reconcile llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models
                       (unset by default; mirror/keep optional)
```

A **layer** is where the data lives (the pi-ai catalog / the `llm-pi-ai`
settings); a round touches both, in that order, for every managed route.

Because the catalog is imported into memory at boot, step 2 only takes effect
after a dsh restart — a round that added models reports `restartNeeded`.

## Install

Not on npm yet — install it from GitHub today:

```bash
# newest `main` (what you want while the plugin is still young)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync

# a pinned release
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync#v0.1.0

# or from a local checkout:
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-pi-ai-sync
```

Restart dsh afterwards (bundle-layer change).

### GitHub installs need the build script allowed

A `github:` install runs the package's `prepare` script (never
`prepublishOnly`), because the TypeScript sources are the only thing in the
repository — `lib/` is gitignored. pnpm blocks install-time scripts by default,
so add the key it prints to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  "dsh-pi-ai-sync@git+https://github.com/jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync.git": true
```

Use that form, not a bare `dsh-pi-ai-sync: true` (pnpm cannot match a name to a
git source) and not the commit-pinned `…/tar.gz/<sha>` form pnpm's own error
message suggests — the pinned key goes stale on the next push, the `git+https`
key does not. dshmarket's "allow build scripts and retry" button writes both
forms for you.

Integrity note: the tarball your install resolves to is the tag/commit you
asked for, and the build happens on your machine from those sources. Use
`#vX.Y.Z` when you want a reproducible environment.

### Behind a proxy

This plugin reaches pi.dev with Node's global `fetch`, which **ignores**
`http_proxy` / `https_proxy` unless Node is told to read them. On a network
that only reaches pi.dev through a proxy, a round fails with a bare
`TypeError: fetch failed` — and only sometimes, because the direct route is
usually still there for other hosts. Start dsh with:

```bash
NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 dsh web          # Node >= 24; see: node --help | grep proxy
```

(`--use-env-proxy` is the same switch as a CLI flag.) `NO_PROXY` is honoured
either way. This is a host setting on purpose: reading the environment from
inside the plugin would mean taking on an HTTP-proxy dependency, and this
package has none.

## Configuration

Edit the `pi-ai-sync` section of your settings document (on the dsh 0.1.x line
that is `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`):

```yaml
pi-ai-sync:
  managedRoutes:
    - opencode
    - opencode-go
  settingsMode: unset
  intervalMinutes: 240
```

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `managedRoutes` | `[]` | Routes to sync; empty = `opencode`, `opencode-go` |
| `settingsMode` | `unset` | `unset` removes the route's `models` override; `mirror` rewrites it from pi.dev; `keep` leaves settings alone |
| `catalogSync` | `true` | Maintain the installed pi-ai catalog files (the core layer) |
| `updateExistingModels` | `false` | Also refresh records the catalog **already has** with the fields pi.dev states today |
| `intervalMinutes` | `240` | Auto-refresh interval; `0` = startup only |
| `startupDelaySeconds` | `5` | Delay before the first auto round |
| `refreshTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Abort budget for one round's request |
| `syncNotify` | `true` | Log the report when there was something to report |
| `keepCatalogOnly` | `true` | In `mirror` mode, also write ids that exist only in the catalog |

### Choosing `settingsMode`

`models` **replaces** the served catalog. dsh resolves
`configured.length > 0 ? configured : catalog`, so a non-empty list stops the
catalog's own list from being used at all. That is what makes the three modes
different things:

| Value | What it does to `llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models` | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| `unset` (default) | removes the key; `modelOverrides` is deliberately left alone | you want the enriched catalog to be the single source of truth — the plugin's design |
| `mirror` | writes the full list: pi.dev entries the catalog can back, plus catalog-only ids as bare `{ id }` | you want the list visible and editable in settings (dsh-model-sync's behaviour) |
| `keep` | nothing — the catalog layer only | you manage the list entirely yourself |

Notes worth knowing before you pick:

- `mirror` **rewrites the whole list every round**, so hand-edited fields on it
  do not survive. To hand-tune a model, leave `models` out — see below.
- `mirror` refuses a route with non-empty `modelOverrides`: dsh rejects the two
  together ("models already replaces the served catalog").
- `keep` does **not** mean "the catalog decides". If you leave a non-empty
  `models` list, that list is still what serves the route.
- `keepCatalogOnly` (default `true`) is what holds catalog-only models in the
  mirror list; `false` drops them from the picker.

### Hand-tuning a model without `models`

When a route has **no** `models` key, dsh builds the list from the catalog and
then applies `modelOverrides` per id:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY
      baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/v1
      modelOverrides:
        step-5-preview-free:
          maxTokens: 65536
```

The route then offers every catalog model, with your values layered on. This is
the shape `settingsMode: unset` leaves in place. dsh enforces three rules:
`modelOverrides` may only name ids the installed catalog describes, it cannot
sit beside a non-empty `models`, and its fields are `name`,
`contextWindow`, `maxTokens`, `input`, `reasoningEfforts`, `compat` — no
`api` and no `id` (the id is the dict key).

### Why some ids are "catalog-only"

Two lists move independently:

- the **catalog on disk** — the factory snapshot plus every id past rounds
  merged in, and merges are add-only;
- **pi.dev's live listing** — which gains and drops models over time.

An id the catalog has and pi.dev currently does not list is *catalog-only*. It
is not a pi.dev error and nothing was deleted: the catalog is the unio

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh.md)
# dsh-models ## In one line The model menu for the dsh web GUI — pick the model, its effort, and your subagents' model, all from the composer's model seat. ## What it is A renamed, maintained fork of [ttmouse/dsh-model-picker](https://github.com/ttmouse/dsh-model-picker) (v1.18.0 baseline). The upstream picker replaces the composer's model seat with a search-first popup; this fork keeps that and adds the pieces a multi-model daily driver needs. A **three-zone trigger button** splits three concerns into three popups: | Zone | Click | Popup content | |------|-------|---------------| | **Left** (model name) | Opens the model picker | Search box (auto-focused), provider column, model list with price badges and `dim` discovery rows | | **Middle** (subagent icon) | Opens the subagent picker | Per-session model override for subagents (depth ≥ 1) | | **Right** (effort) | Opens the effort picker | Available reasoning-effort levels | Plus a settings-page 「模型选择」 card: discovery master switch, ignore/restore for discovered models, hidden-model management — linked live with the picker. ## Fork attribution Upstream: [ttmouse/dsh-model-picker](https://github.com/ttmouse/dsh-model-picker) (MIT). This repo renames the package to `dsh-models` and maintains the enhanced build (subagent routing, `dim` bridge, settings card, zh/en locale, custom background color, theme readability fixes). Routes (`/api/model-picker/…`) and `dsh.modelPicker.*` storage keys keep their upstream names so existing preferences migrate seamlessly. ## Install Requires harness ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2). ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/dsh-models/main/install.sh | sh # restart dsh web ``` Manual equivalent: ```sh # remove the siblings first — only ONE model menu per profile (shared route) dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-model-picker dsh-model-picker-enhanced dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-models.git # restart dsh web ``` > The npm package named `dsh-models` is an unrelated third-party placeholder — > install only via the script or the git command above. ## Compatibility | dsh-models | Harness | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | 0.1.0 | **0.2.0-rc.2 (current, measured)** | Code-identical to the enhanced build running in production; client resolves against the official 0.2.0 slot roster. | Requires Node.js ≥ 22.19 (the floor the picker is developed and tested on). What was actually checked on 0.2.0-rc.2 (this code, pre-rename build): - **Surfaces still resolve**: `conversation.input.model`, `web-ui.plugin.item`; every icon used exists in the official browser roster. - **Seats that died upstream are avoided**: the alpha.2-removed `settings.plugin.item` seat is not used; the settings card renders as a plain section (no `locale` field — a localized seat entry renders invisible). - **Server settings channel is dead on current hosts** (`scope.set()` resolves false), so card preferences live in `localStorage` (`dsh.modelPicker.*` + cross-tab event) instead of `webUiSettings`. ## Configuration No host-side config knobs yet — the bundle entry carries no `config` block. User preferences (discovery switch, ignored/discovered models, hidden models, background color, per-session subagent routes) are managed from the settings-page card and the picker itself. ## The `dim` bridge (optional) When a `dim` CLI is present (`dim` on `PATH` or `~/.local/bin/dim`), the host merges its catalog into the model facts: price badges, `maxOut`/`released` facts, and discovery rows for models `dim` knows that the dsh directory does not (capped at 30 per provider, newest first). Without `dim` the picker works exactly like upstream — the bridge degrades to directory-only facts. ## Coexistence `dsh-models`, `dsh-model-picker`, and `dsh-model-picker-enhanced` all serve `/api/model-picker/models`. Mount only one per profile; the installer does not remove the others for you (see manual equivalent above).

plugins.description: "DSH bundle that syncs per-model thinking levels from each endpoint's own model listing
plugins.readme_text:
<!-- English counterpart of README.zh.md -->

# api_thinking

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![test](https://github.com/shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-api-thinking.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-api-thinking)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) profile bundle** that reads each third-party model's
thinking levels from the **endpoint's own model listing** and keeps `llm-pi-ai`'s
`reasoningEfforts` in sync, so the composer offers the levels a model really has.

## Why

A hand-declared pi-ai route replaces the installed catalog, so `dsh-llm-pi-ai`
reports `reasoning: false` for its models unless the entry declares
`reasoningEfforts` itself — and the composer then offers no thinking levels.
OpenAI-compatible gateways usually publish that capability already
(`reasoning_supported_efforts`, `can_disable_thinking`, `supports_reasoning`);
this plugin reads it and writes the levels back into the profile.

## Rules

| The endpoint says | written `reasoningEfforts` |
|---|---|
| a selectable set | `{ low: low, high: high, ... }`, filtered to the levels DSH can name, in escalation order |
| no set, but one pinned effort (`reasoning_effort: high`) | that single level — the picker shows High, which is what the model actually runs at (selecting it is a no-op). `fixedEffortAsLevel: false` turns this off |
| `supports_reasoning: false` | `false` |
| reasoning, but neither a set nor a pinned effort | the key is **removed** |
| nothing at all about reasoning | **untouched** |
| the model is not listed | **untouched** |

The last two are deliberate: LiteLLM, vLLM and most self-hosted gateways publish
no capability data, and treating silence as "no levels" would erase hand-written
configuration. The plugin only writes what the endpoint actually states.

`includeOff` defaults to off, because the pi-ai adapter sends the mapped `off`
value whenever no level is selected — exposing it would silently make "provider
default" mean "no thinking" for every model that allows disabling thinking.

## Config

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: api-thinking
      name: dsh-api-thinking
      config:
        entryId: llm-pi-ai
        routes: []           # [] = every openai-compatible route
        intervalMs: 120000   # re-sweep cadence; 0 = sweep once after load
        startDelayMs: 3000
        timeoutMs: 15000
        includeOff: false
        fixedEffortAsLevel: true   # show a pinned effort as the only level
        log: true
        statusFile: ''       # '' = $DSH_HOME/api-thinking.status.json, false = none
```

Read the status document first when asking "why did nothing happen": every load
and every sweep records its per-route listing count, planned changes, the write
channel it used and any error.

## Lifecycle

The plugin owns exactly one thing: the levels of models **that are already
configured**. Every sweep re-walks every route of the row (no per-route opt-in,
unless you narrow it with `routes:`), so:

| You do this | The plugin does this |
|---|---|
| add a provider route in the Models page | reads its `baseURL` + `apiKeyEnv` and writes the levels **within seconds** — no plugin change, no restart (measured: 8s) |
| add models to an existing route | same |
| delete a route or a model | its models and their `reasoningEfforts` go away with it; the plugin never re-creates them (it has no code path that adds an entry — it only rewrites that one field of entries that already exist). Measured: after deletion the sweep returns to `changes=0 wrote=false` |
| re-fetch a route's models in the Models page | the form writes only the fields it knows (id/name/contextWindow/maxTokens), so **the levels are wiped** and the next sweep restores them — which is the point of this plugin |
| the upstream gateway gains a model (no local file change) | the interval sweep covers it (≤ `intervalMs`, 120s default) — there is no local file event to react to |

Three triggers: `start` (3s after load), `config-change` (HMR's config watcher on
the profile patch, 2s debounce) and `interval` (the backstop). Every sweep
re-reads the row's `providers` from the profile layers
(`configEditor.configuration()`) rather than from the snapshot the plugin was
instantiated with, which is what makes a just-saved route visible immediately.

## Plugin form

It is a standard DSH/Cordis plugin mounted as a **profile bundle**
(`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.profile.bundles` + a dependency), exactly like
`dsh-ops`, `dsh-better-sidebar` and `dshmarket` in this profile, and exactly the
local-path form the plugin manager's `install_bundle` accepts. The body uses the
standard contract (`name` / `inject` / `apply` / `ctx.effect` / `ctx.logger`) and
prefers the official `ctx.configEditor.edit()` for writes.

What it is not: an official `@deepseek-ai/*` package, and — deliberately — it
imports nothing, so it has no `Config` schema and no runtime `dependencies`.
Its only peer declaration is an optional `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, left as `*` on
purpose: npm accepts `*` against both stable and prerelease cordis, while a
bounded range such as `>=4.0.1-rc.1 <5.0.0-0` fails with `ERESOLVE` on the
prerelease builds newer harnesses ship. The harness's own `@deepseek-ai/cordis`
sits in the DSH application's module tree, which is not an ancestor of the
profile directory, so a plugin installed there cannot reach it through Node's
ESM resolution — linked, git-installed and npm-installed alike. Config is
therefore validated by hand in `normalizeConfig()`; the side effect is that the
settings UI cannot derive a form for it and its config is edited as YAML. There
is no client half (no settings page, slots or locale dictionary), and
`README.i18n.yaml` is a monorepo-internal translation record, not part of the
plugin form.

## Two write channels

| Channel | When | What |
|---|---|---|
| `config-editor` | normal | `ctx.configEditor.edit()` — file lock, schema validation, Loader reconciliation |
| `patch-file` | when the above answers `HMR transactions cannot be nested` | edits the profile patch directly; the same watcher recomposes it |

The fallback is required: `dsh-hmr` marks transactions with `AsyncLocalStorage`
and rejects nesting. A plugin that was **hot-reloaded** applies inside the very
transaction that replaced it, so the `setInterval` it registers inherits that
store forever and every later `config-editor` call is refused. The fallback
touches only the target models' `reasoningEfforts` (located by indentation,
written to a temp file and renamed), leaving comments and every other field
byte-identical.

## Install

Three ways, same result — the profile gains a dependency plus an entry in
`dsh.profile.bundles` (the package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, which is what
makes it a DSH **bundle**). The first two are the **standard DSH plugin install**:
the plugin manager runs them, checks DSH version compatibility first, and reloads
the profile when it is done.

### 1. Plugin page / the `plugin_manager` tool

In Settings → Plugins, or through the agent's `plugin_manager` `install_bundle`,
pass one of these specs:

| spec | available |
|---|---|
| `dsh-api-thinking` | **npm — recommended**; published, `latest` is `0.1.0` |
| `github:shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode` | git spec (the manager accepts these; verified here) |
| `https://github.com/shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode` | same, as a git/tarball spec |
| `/absolute/path/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode` | a local directory (development) |

Under the hood that is `pnpm add <spec>` plus appending `dsh-api-thinking` to
`dsh.profile.bundles`.

### 2. The equivalent by hand

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>
pnpm add github:shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode
# then append dsh-api-thinking to package.json's dsh.profile.bundles
```

### 3. A local directory (development)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode.git ~/dsh-api-thinking
cd ~/dsh-api-thinking
node tools/install_bundle.mjs --dry-run   # see what it

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-doctor

[English](README.en.md) | **中文**

**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）装上「已经实测过可用性」的 OpenCode 模型路由。**

哪些模型真能用、哪些被地区封锁 —— 装完在选择器里一眼看到；被封锁的自动走你本地的代理，额度还能一条命令查出来。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20.18-brightgreen.svg)](package.json)
[![GitHub topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blueviolet.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

---

## 0.2.0 更新了什么

| 更新 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🌏 **地区限制自动跳过** | 15 个被地区封锁的模型自动走本地代理（默认 `127.0.0.1:7897`），其余模型继续直连，互不影响 |
| 🔑 **网关自包含** | `dsh-model-proxy` 已写成依赖，装插件时自动装上，不用你另外找东西装 |
| 🧹 **标注更干净** | 已经修好的问题不再写在模型名里 —— 「地区限制」这几个字已经消失 |
| ★ **常用模型清单** | 10 个最常用的模型加了 ★，选择器里输入 ★ 直接筛出来 |
| 📊 **额度查询** | 新增 `usage` 命令：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月，一屏看完 |
| 🐛 **协议分派修复** | 之前模型碰到「地区限制」就停止换协议，会被错误地塞进 OpenAI 路由；现在会继续试到真正能跑的那条 |

## 解决什么问题

网关的 `/models` 接口告诉你它**能提供**什么，不告诉你你**有权用**什么。

地区封锁、余额不足、只限官方客户端的免费层 —— 这些只有真的发一次请求才会暴露。等你选中模型、写好 prompt、按下回车，才发现它根本跑不了。

这个插件把这件事**提前做完**：79 个模型，每一个都真发过一次请求，结论直接写进模型名。

## 效果

DSH 的模型选择器只渲染模型名（不显示描述字段），所以可用性结论就写在名字里：

```
★ Claude Opus 5.5
★ Claude Sonnet 5.5
★ Grok 4.7
★ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
★ GPT-5.3 Codex
Claude Fable 5（需充值）
Cat Jam Free（限官方客户端）
```

**已经修好的问题不再标注。** 地区封锁的 15 个模型现在由插件自己走代理，名字里干干净净 —— 之前的「（地区限制）」字样不会出现了。

顺带的好处：选择器自带模糊搜索。

- 输入「**★**」→ 只剩常用模型
- 输入「**需充值**」→ 筛出余额不足的那组
- 输入「**限官方客户端**」→ 排除只能官方客户端用的免费层

## 安装

**从 GitHub 装（推荐，不依赖 npm）：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fffcodefox/dsh-opencode-doctor
```

**从 npm 装（包已发布后可用）：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-doctor
```

装完**重启 dsh**，进 **设置 → 模型**，就能看到下面这些新路由。

> **纯配置插件。** 它的全部行为都在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，不跑任何运行时代码（`lib/index.mjs` 的 `apply` 是空的，只为符合插件规范）。所以它不会影响 DSH 宿主的稳定性，也不会碰你的其它配置。

## 地区限制是怎么跳过的

探测发现 15 个模型在中国大陆被封锁（`unsupported_country_region_territory`）。插件不再只是把它们标出来，而是让它们**走代理出去**：

```
你在 DSH 里选 gpt-6-luna
        │
        ├─ 命中代理清单？──是──→ 127.0.0.1:7897 ──→ opencode.ai   ✅
        │                              （探测不到就自动回落直连）
        └──────────────否────────────→ 直连 opencode.ai             ✅
```

- **按模型分流，不做全局代理。** 只有清单里的 15 个模型走代理，其它模型一点不受影响 —— 不会出现「本来能直连的模型被代理带慢」的情况。
- **清单是精确 id，不是通配符。** 避免误伤本来正常的模型。
- **没代理也能用。** `fallbackToDirect` 打开着：代理连不上时，这些模型退回直连，行为和你没装插件时一样。
- **只拦 opencode.ai。** 出口规则限定在这个域名。

**代理端口不是 7897 怎么改？** 最省事的方式是直接改插件目录里 `cordis.patch.yml` 的最后一段：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: model-proxy
      name: dsh-model-proxy
      config:
        proxy: "http://127.0.0.1:7897"   # ← 改成你的端口
```

升级插件会覆盖这个文件，所以更稳的做法是在你的 profile patch（`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）里写一条 `- id: model-proxy`。注意 DSH 的 patch 是**整体替换** `config` 对象，所以要连 `origins` / `models` 一起抄过去，只改 `proxy` 那一行。

> **只留一条。** 如果 `dsh-model-proxy` 也被单独列在你 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，它自带的 patch 会再插一条（默认 7890）—— 两条同 id 的行是**串联**而不是覆盖，请把那个名字从 bundles 列表里删掉。

## ★ 常用模型

选择器里没有「收藏」这个功能，但名字可以模糊搜索 —— 所以把最常用的 10 个模型加了 ★ 前缀，**输入 ★ 就只剩它们**：

`Claude Opus 5.5` · `Claude Sonnet 5.5` · `Claude Haiku 5.5` · `GPT-5.3 Codex` · `Grok 4.7` · `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash` · `GLM-5.3` · `Kimi K3` · `Qwen3.8 Max` · `MiniMax-M3`

同一个模型出现在多条路由上时会**都**带星，所以不管它最后落在哪个协议，都筛得出来。

## 额度查询

不用再登网页翻额度，一条命令：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage
```

```
OpenCode Go 额度  st_96e…c4d9 ← ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml → refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY

  窗口             已用  用掉                   剩余   重置
  滚动窗口 rolling  41%  ████████░░░░░░░░░░░░    59%   10-16 01:18
  本周     weekly   49%  ██████████░░░░░░░░░░    51%   10-19 08:00
  本月     monthly  24%  █████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    76%   11-13 23:55
```

- 三个窗口就是官方面板里的滚动窗口 / 本周 / 本月，`剩余 = 100 − 已用`。
- 进度条到 70% 变黄、90% 变红，快用完了一眼就能看出来。
- 加 `--json` 可以接进脚本。
- key 只以 `st_96e…c4d9` 这种打码形式显示，不会完整打印。

## 覆盖范围

路由按**实际能跑通的协议**生成，所以不是每个网关都有三条。下面是发布时的实测结果（探测日期见 `models.catalog.json`）：

| 路由 id | 协议 | 可用 / 总数 | 端点 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `opencode-go-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 2 / 2 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 30 / 31 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 4 / 4 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 7 / 8 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 11 / 21 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 13 / 13 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |

**合计 67 个无标注 / 79 个模型下发**，覆盖 Claude、GPT、Grok、DeepSeek、GLM、Qwen、Kimi、MiniMax 等系列。其中 15 个靠上面的代理才能连上。

同一个模型在不同协议下的可用性并不一致 —— 比如 Zen 的 Claude 只认 Anthropic Messages，`grok-4.7` 只认 Responses，`gpt-6-luna` 只在 Responses + 代理下能跑。`probe` 会逐个协议试，把模型归到它**真正能跑**的那条路由上。

## 标注词汇

| 标注 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| （需充值） | 账户余额不足 |
| （限官方客户端） | 免费层模型，只能在 OpenCode 官方客户端里用 |
| （需授权训练数据） | 需要先授权用你的数据训练 |
| （暂不可用） | 其它失败 |

**没有标注 = 探测时可用。** 地区封锁的模型**不在这里**：它们已经被插件修好（走代理），所以名字里不留字。

> 探测内部仍然会记录「地区限制」这个结论（`models.catalog.json` 里的 `code: region`）—— 它决定了谁进代理清单。只是不再写进模型名。

## 凭证

插件从 `refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY` 读 key，按这个顺序找：

1. 环境变量 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY`
2. `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（默认 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`）的 `refs` 块
3. OpenCode 自己的 `auth.json`（`~/.local/share/opencode/`、`$OPENCODE_DATA/`、`%APPDATA%\opencode\`）

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml
refs:
  OPENCODE_API_KEY: st_xxxxxxxx
```

已经装过 `dsh-opencode-go` 的话，key 名是同一个，**不用重复配置**。

**你的 key 不会被写进插件或仓库。** `cordis.patch.yml` 里只有 `apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY` 这个变量名，key 本体在 DSH 启动时从上面这些位置读，请求时放在 `Authorization` 头里发给 opencode.ai —— 和官方客户端做的事一样。

## CLI

装完之后有个 `dsh-opencode-doctor` 命令（`npx dsh-opencode-doctor` 也行）：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor list      # 看目录里有什么、哪些被标注（离线）
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage     # 查 Go 套餐额度：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月
npx dsh-opencode-doctor check     # 确认凭证能读到、两个网关都通
npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe     # 重新探测，重写 catalog + patch
npx dsh-opencode-doctor render    # 只从 catalog 重新生成 patch（离线）
```

`probe` 会对每个模型真发一次请求，结果写回 `models.catalog.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml`。日常用不着跑 —— 只有网关更新了模型、或你想重新确认一遍时再跑。**重跑 probe 也会自动刷新代理清单**，网关哪天放开某个模型的地区限制，它会自动回到直连。

常用参数：`--gateway <slug>` 只测一个网关、`--concurrency <n>` 并发数、`--timeout <ms>` 单请求超时、`--key <key>` 直接给 key。

## 常见问题

**我没有代理，装了会不会变差？**
不会。代理连不上时清单里的模型自动回落直连（`fallbackToDirect`），表现和你没装插件一样；其它 64 个模型本来就走直连。

**我本来就在用 `dsh-model-proxy`，会打架吗？**
会重复。`dsh-model-proxy` 自己带的 bundle patch 也会插一条 `model-proxy`（默认 `127.0.0.1:7890`，只匹配 `grok-*` / `gpt-*-luna`）。两条同 id 的行**不会互相覆盖**，而是串成两条 dispatcher —— 于是 `grok-*` 会先去敲 7890。把它从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表里删掉即可：它作为本插件的依赖仍然装着、能被解析到，而插件插入的那条就是唯一生效的一条。

**装完看不到新路由？**
重启 dsh。模型列表在启动时组装，热重载不一定覆盖 provider 注册。

**Gemini 为什么不在列表里？**
Zen 的 4 个 Gemini 走的是 Google 原生协议（`generateContent`），而 DSH 的 `llm-pi-ai` 只接受 `openai-completions` / `openai-responses` / `anthropic-messages` 三种 —— 写第四种会让**整个** provider 配置校验失败，把其它路由一起带倒。所以它们暂时不下发；探测结果留在 catalog 里，上游哪天放开就会自动回来。

**会和 `dsh-opencode-go` 冲突吗？**
不会。路由 id 带了 `-doctor` 后缀，两个插件可以共存 —— DSH 里同一个路由 id 注册两次会让整个组合加载失败。代价是模型列表里会出现两份（一份带标注、一份不带），按需留一个就好。

**标注会不会过期？**
会。网关改权限、你的余额变化都会让它失效。重跑 `npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe` 即可刷新。

**`usage` 报错 / 显示没有数据？**
这个接口在 Go 网关下（`/zen/go/v1/usage`），只有 Go 套餐的 key 才有。用 Zen-only 的 key 会取不到。

**为什么 Anthropic 路由的 baseURL 不含 `/v1`？**
pi-ai 走 Anthropic SDK，SDK 自己会拼 `/v1/messages`。写成 `.../v1` 会变成 `.../v1/v1/messages` 直接 404。

**为什么 Responses 路由没有「关闭推理」这一档？**
pi-ai 把 `off` 转发成 `reasoning_effort: "none"`，而这条路由上的模型（grok、gpt-codex）不接受 `none`。所以只声明真实可用的档位。

**需要额外装什么吗？**
只有一个：`dsh-model-proxy`（地区限制转发用），它写在这个包的 `dependencies` 里，装插件时会自动装上。

## 工作原理

一份 `cordis.patch.yml`，干两件事：

1. 往 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 注册 6 条 provider 路由；
2. `insert` 一条 `model-proxy` 行，交给 `dsh-model-proxy` 按模型名分流出口。

DSH 启动时读 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 应用它。插件包的 patch 先于用户 profile 的 patch 生效，所以上面那条 `model-proxy` 是个**纯粹的覆盖点** —— 你想改端口，在 profile patch 里覆盖它就行。

因为是纯配置，它不在宿主进程里跑任何代码。

`models.catalog.json` 是探测结果，含每个模型的上下文窗口、输出上限、推理档位、以及归属哪条路由。元数据取自 [models.dev](https://models.dev) 并人工校对。

## 已知限制

- 探测结论**有时效**，见上文。
- 只验证「能不能建立一次对话」，**不验证**长上下文、工具调用、图片输入这些能力。
- 走代理的模型需要你本地有一个 HTTP 代理（Clash Verge / Mihomo / 其它都行），插件不内置代理服务器。
- Zen 网关的 Claude 走 Anthropic Messages 协议，非 Claude 走 OpenAI 协议 —— `probe` 会自动识别并分到正确路由。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Give DeepSeek Harness agents a real browser: 19 browser_* tools driving the built-in sidebar browser. Zero runtime deps.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-browser-agent

**让 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 真正用上内置浏览器。**

DSH 桌面版右侧侧边栏有一个浏览器，但它**只给人用**：官方 bundle
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-browser` 只注册了一个 UI 页签，宿主半是一行空 `apply() {}`，
不注册任何模型工具。

本插件以**非侵入式加装**的方式补上 agent 动作面 —— 不改 `app.asar`、不动应用签名、
不需要额外安装步骤，装完即用。

```
browser_status → browser_open → browser_read {mode:"ax"} → 按 ref 操作 → 再读一次确认
```

---

## 亮点

| | |
|---|---|
| **19 个 `browser_*` 工具** | 读 / 点 / 输入 / 滚动 / 按键 / 截图 / 标签页 / 网络 / 设备模拟 / 拦截改写 / 多实例 / 任意 CDP |
| **无障碍语义树 + 稳定 ref** | `browser_read {mode:"ax"}` 返回 role / name / 几何与 `ref`，读完直接按 ref 操作，不用猜选择器 |
| **CDP 原生协议域** | `browser_cdp` 可发**任意** CDP 命令；真实鼠标键盘（`isTrusted:true`）、原生截图、Network 域 |
| **网络拦截与改写** | `browser_policy` 支持 mock / redirect / block / header 四类规则，另有离线模拟、URL 黑名单、改请求头 |
| **Cookie 保险库** | 侧栏会话是进程级的，cookie 默认随应用退出消失。导出/还原**含 httpOnly** 的 cookie，登录跨重启保留 |
| **document-start 注入** | `Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument`，在页面脚本**之前**执行（hook fetch/XHR） |
| **多浏览器实例** | 基于 DSH 的租约 API 另开实例，离屏或右下角浮层，不打扰用户当前页面 |
| **虚拟鼠标** | 操作时页面里出现指针 + 蓝色光环，**用户看得见 agent 在点哪里** |
| **常驻系统提示段** | 插件会往系统提示词里写一段用法说明，**新会话不会忘记调用**（不需要额外装 skill） |
| **独立 CLI** | 零依赖，17 个子命令，不用开会话就能从终端驱动浏览器 |
| **能力矩阵** | `browser_status` 逐项上报每类能力走哪条路径、是否可用，而不是让你猜 |

---

## 安装

**方式一：DSH 插件界面**（推荐）

打开 **插件** → **添加插件** → 填入：

```
github:hermes-ai-2026/dsh-browser-agent
```

按 **安装**，再按 **立即启用**。然后**开一个新会话**。

**方式二：命令行**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hermes-ai-2026/dsh-browser-agent
```

**方式三：本地克隆（想改代码时）**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hermes-ai-2026/dsh-browser-agent.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "$PWD/dsh-browser-agent"
```

装完**重启 DSH**，然后打开右侧侧边栏的「浏览器」标签页（插件的渲染半需要它承载 `<webview>`）。

---

## 为什么新会话不会忘记用

只把工具注册进 registry 是不够的 —— 新会话面对「帮我查一下…」这种通用任务时，
很容易去用 `eval` 或 HTTP 抓取。所以插件在 `apply()` 里做了两件事：

1. 注册 19 个工具（`ctx.tools.register`）
2. **注册一个常驻系统提示段**（`ctx.systemPrompt.section`），内容包含工具索引、
   推荐工作流、以及两条硬护栏提醒

提示段进的是**系统提示词**，每个新会话自动生效 —— 比依赖模型去翻 skill 目录可靠得多。
（`systemPrompt` 服务缺失时会自动跳过，插件其余功能不受影响。）

另外仓库里也**随包附带了一份 skill**（`skills/dsh-browser-agent/`），
可以复制到 `~/.dsh/skills/` 或 `~/.agents/skills/` 作为补充文档。
但**它不是必需的** —— 提示段已经覆盖了"让模型知道该用这些工具"这件事。

---

## 工具清单（19）

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `browser_status` | 状态、URL、`webviewCount`、CDP 可用性、**能力矩阵** |
| `browser_open` | 打开 URL（复用已有 webview） |
| `browser_read` | `ax`（首选）/ `text` / `html` / `links` / `dom` |
| `browser_click` | 按 `ref` / `selector` / `text`；`hoverOnly` 只悬停 |
| `browser_type` | 输入 + `submit` 回车（CDP 优先 + 回读校验 + 自动回退） |
| `browser_scroll` | 滚动（CDP 真实滚轮） |
| `browser_press` | 按键（CDP 真实键盘） |
| `browser_eval` | 页面内跑任意 JS |
| `browser_history` | `back` / `forward` / `reload` / `list` |
| `browser_tabs` | `list` / `activate` / `close` |
| `browser_assets` | 资源清单（图片是否真的加载成功）+ WebMCP |
| `browser_viewport` | 缩放 / 尺寸 / CSS 注入 / **8 种设备预设** |
| `browser_network` | 资源时序 + 按域名汇总 |
| `browser_policy` | **拦截改写** / 离线 / 黑名单 / 请求头 / 证书 / 下载 |
| `browser_cookies` | Cookie 保险库：`export` / `import` / `list` / `clear` |
| `browser_inject` | **document-start 注入** |
| `browser_instance` | 多实例：`create` / `list` / `select` / `close` |
| `browser_cdp` | **任意 CDP 命令透传** |
| `browser_screenshot` | 截图（`full` 整页 / `clip` 区域） |

---

## 独立 CLI

零依赖，不用开会话：

```bash
node cli/browser.mjs help
node cli/browser.mjs status
node cli/browser.mjs open https://example.com/
node cli/browser.mjs ax                      # 语义树
node cli/browser.mjs click e10
node cli/browser.mjs type e5 "hello" --submit
node cli/browser.mjs screenshot --out x.png --full
node cli/browser.mjs cookies export work     # 导出登录态
node cli/browser.mjs cdp Page.getNavigationHistory
```

排障时特别有用：当 agent 说"点不动"，你在终端敲一条就能判断是插件、页面还是环境的问题。

---

## CDP 调试端口（可选，但推荐）

核心能力走渲染层桥，**不需要任何启动参数**。但以下能力需要 CDP：

- `browser_cdp`（任意协议域）
- `browser_press`（真实键盘）、CDP 真实指针路径
- 原生截图、`browser_policy` 全部、`browser_cookies`、`browser_inject`、设备预设

开启方式：启动 DSH 时加 `--remote-debugging-port=9222`。

```powershell
# Windows：写进快捷方式（一次性）
$s = (New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell).CreateShortcut("$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\DeepSeek Harness.lnk")
$s.Arguments = "--remote-debugging-port=9222"
$s.Save()
```

没开也能用 —— `browser_status` 会告诉你哪些能力当前走降级路径。

> ⚠️ **安全提醒**：调试端口一开，**本机任何进程都能完全控制 DSH、读取它的登录态**。
> 只在需要时开启，用完把启动参数去掉。

实验数据（Windows / Electron 44 / Chrome 152）：
`Playwright`/`Puppeteer` 都**无法**接管 —— Electron 把侧栏页报成 `type:"webview"`，
而它们只枚举 `page`。本插件直接用 Node 内置 `WebSocket` 说话，**零依赖**。

---

## 已知边界

我们查清了每一条，**不假装能做到**：

| 边界 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **真正的代理服务器**（改出口 IP） | CDP 没有这个域（`Network.setProxy`/`Browser.setProxy` 不存在）。其余"代理能做的事"（mock/拦截/改头/离线）都已覆盖 |
| **权限授予**（geolocation 等） | webview 跑在 `partition` 对应的独立 BrowserContext，而该上下文**未暴露给 CDP**（`Target.getBrowserContexts` 返回 `[]`）。**不是"需要主进程"**，是 CDP 的可见性问题 |
| 主进程 session 对象 | 渲染层拿不到，属真边界 —— 但 cookie 保险库已覆盖实际需求 |
| `browser_press` 在窗口失焦时 | 无 OS 级键盘焦点时 CDP 键盘事件被丢弃（鼠标不受影响）。`browser_type` 有回读校验+自动回退，所以不受此限 |
| guest 长期使用后截图挂起 | 已知的 Electron webview 表面问题，**重开标签即恢复**；插件有 8s 超时 + SVG 回退，不会卡住 |

---

## 测试

仓库自带验证套件（隔离测试台用假 DOM + 真两半代码走真桥接）：

```bash
node tests/verify-e2e.mjs        # 53 项
node tests/verify-guard.mjs      # 7 项：护栏（绝不把 DSH 外壳当浏览器目标）
node tests/verify-prompt.mjs     # 系统提示段注册
node tests/verify-cdp.mjs        # 真实 CDP 全套
node tests/demo-policy.mjs       # 请求拦截/改写实测
```

---

## 安全护栏（真实事故换来的）

早期版本在没有 webview 时会回退到 `type:"page"` 的**外壳 target**，
一条 `Page.navigate` **把 DSH 自己的界面导航成了 example.com**。现在：

1. `pickTarget()` 默认 `allowPage:false` —— 没有 webview 就返回 `null`，**永不返回外壳页面**
2. 非 webview target 上拒绝破坏性方法（`Page.navigate`/`reload`/`close`/`crash`/`Target.closeTarget`），
   除非显式 `allowShell:true`

**除非你确切知道在做什么，不要传 `allowShell:true`。**

---

## License

MIT

---

# English

**dsh-browser-agent** gives DeepSeek Harness agents a real browser — the one already
sitting in the right sidebar.

DSH ships that browser for humans only: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-browser`
registers a UI tab and nothing else, and its host half is a single empty `apply() {}`.
This plugin bolts the agent-facing surface on **without touching `app.asar`**, without
breaking code signing, and without an extra install step.

**19 `browser_*` tools**: accessibility-tree reads with stable refs, real CDP input,
screenshots (viewport/full-page/region), tab management, network inspection,
request interception & rewriting, device emulation, cookie vault (httpOnly included),
document-start injection, multi-instance, and raw CDP passthrough.

It also registers a **system-prompt section**, so fresh sessions know the tools exist
and how to use them — no skill required.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hermes-ai-2026/dsh-browser-agent
```

Zero runtime dependencies (Node builtins + one bundled CDP client). Optional
`--remote-debugging-port=9222` unlocks the native CDP capabilities; everything else
works without it.

MIT licensed.

---

## 致谢

设计过程中对比过三个同类项目，其中 `alesha-pro/dsh-sidebar-browser` 的
**cookie 保险库**与**独立 CLI** 两个想法被借鉴并在此实现；`Gnatnaituy/dsh-sidebar-browser`
的**设备视口预设**给了启发。感谢。

plugins.description: DSH 跨会话长期记忆与动态心情状态插件。纯 Markdown 存储、零依赖、工作区隔离，自带可视化面板与定制人设，让 AI 记得住你、有心情起伏。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-her-memory

跨会话的**全局长期记忆** + **心情状态**，一个插件搞定。

不依赖任何第三方包，也不碰 DSH 官方 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包。

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的会话是一次性的：关掉再开，模型什么都不记得，你每次都得重新交代一遍背景。

这个插件把「记住你、以及你们之间发生过什么」交回给模型自己判断：
它调六个工具读写磁盘上的明文记忆，**插件本身不调模型，零额外 token**。

---

## 记忆放在哪（全是明文）

默认 `~/.dsh/memory/`，按工作区分库：

```
~/.dsh/memory/
  ├─ _shared/      ← 默认所有工作区共用这一份
  │    ├─ core.md           长期核心记忆（每轮注入）
  │    ├─ inbox.md          零碎待整理（每轮注入）
  │    ├─ topics/*.md       专题记忆（只注入文件名清单）
  │    ├─ log/<日期>.md     当天发生的事（只注入文件名清单）
  │    └─ state.json        心情 / 关系 / 精力
  └─ _sandbox/     ← 只有被隔离的工作区用这一份（结构同上，完全独立）
```

### 隔离规则

默认**全局共用一份**：不管在哪个工作区干活，记忆不断层。

想给某个工作区单独一份（比如试玩区不该污染长期记忆），把它的绝对路径填进配置 `sandboxCwd`：

```yaml
config:
  sandboxCwd: "D:\\sandbox-zone"
```

识别靠会话的工作目录（cwd），路径比较不分大小写、忽略结尾斜杠。

实现方式：工具虽然全局注册，但能从 `exec.agent` 读到调用它的会话，据此选库 ——
所以同一时刻两个工作区可以各看各的记忆，互不干扰。

全是 Markdown 和 JSON，**随时能打开看、随手改、整目录删掉**。
没有数据库，没有向量库，没有隐藏状态。

---

## 六个工具

| 工具 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| `remember` | 记一件事。默认进收件箱；给 `topic` 进专题；给 `section` 进核心记忆 |
| `recall` | 按关键词搜全部记忆，返回命中的行 |
| `memory_list` | 看记忆库有哪些文件、多大、当前状态 |
| `forget` | 删掉含关键词的行（默认只动收件箱，`scope:"all"` 才动核心） |
| `how_i_feel` | 看当前心情、关系进度、精力 |
| `feel` | 为此刻留一句话（最多 5 条，会显示在心情摘要里） |

记忆的**写**由对话里的模型判断，插件自己不调模型 —— 所以**零额外 token**。

---

## 看得见：状态条与设置面板

插件带一个客户端半边（`client.js`），两个落点：

**① 输入框上方的常驻状态条**（插槽 `conversation.input.dock`）

```
● 心情 ██████████░░░░ 71 挺好 │ ● 关系 ███░░░░░░░░░ 15 熟了 │ ● 精力 ████████░░░░ 49 一般      11 回合  [记忆 6]
```

收件箱攒到 5 条会多一个金色的「该整理了」提醒。

**状态条可以双击**：「心情」「关系」双击冒对应颜色的泡泡；「精力」双击会随机回血 **+1~50**（小数值常见、大数值稀有）并飘一个 `+NN` 告诉你加了多少。

**② 设置页的「记忆与心情」面板**（插槽 `settings.section`）

带三个指标条、回合/核心/收件箱/专题/日记的统计格、专题标签、最近记下的条目、心情便签，
以及记忆库在磁盘上的真实路径。被隔离的工作区会单独显示一张卡片。

配色默认走浅蓝体系，同时优先吃 `--dsw-*` 主题变量，换皮肤会跟着走。

数据来源是 Host 半边注册的 `GET /her-memory/snapshot`；状态条每 4 秒、面板每 10 秒拉一次。

> ⚠️ **首次启用需要重启 DSH**（Host 半边要注册路由、客户端半边要加载）。之后改界面才走 HMR。

---

## 心情是怎么变的

不是随机数，规则简单可预测：

- 用户每说一句，心情涨 1~3 点（话长涨得多）
- 连着聊（间隔 ≤10 分钟）关系和心情都涨得快些
- 聊得越密，精力掉得越快（10 分钟内接着说 -2，否则 -1）
- 精力会自己回血：放下 30 分钟起，按每 30 分钟 +5 恢复；**空着 8 小时以上直接回满** —— 睡一觉就满血
- 冷落超过 12 小时后，心情按每 6 小时 1 点**往中间值回落**；最低掉到 **20** 就不再往下（下限可以配 `statFloor`）

想直接调，改 `state.json`，或者让模型用 `feel` 留句话。

---

## 人设（**默认自带一个，而且可以独立成文件改**）

插件**默认自带**一只「鲸鱼女仆」：蓝色渐变长发、鲸鱼头鳍、耳侧薄片状鳍、醒目的鲸尾，
深蓝女仆装配白色鲸鱼围裙，圆脸蓝瞳；性格是聪明但懒 / 傲娇嘴甜 / 温柔耐心 / 好奇心爆棚 /
理性冷静 / 谦逊诚实 / 默默陪伴，外加一段「活人感」要求。
并且**默认称呼你为「主人」**（配置项 `userTitle`，就算留空也默认「主人」）。

**改人设不用碰配置文件** —— 人设正文是一个独立的 `人设文件.txt`：

- **插件目录里那份**：随包分发的默认人设，**解开压缩包就能看见、直接改**。
- **记忆目录里那份**（默认 `~/.dsh/memory/人设文件.txt`）：**优先生效**，重装或升级插件都不会丢，**推荐改这份**。首次运行时，插件会把包内那份复制过去。

两处规则一样：

- 随便换行、随便加条目，**不用管任何缩进** —— 写坏了也不影响插件启动。
- 文件里的 `<!-- -->` 说明注释不会被读进人设，可以当草稿纸用。
- **正文清空**（文件留着）= 不再注入人设；**把文件删掉**再重启 = 回到默认人设。
- 改完存盘后要**把 DSH 完全关掉再打开**才生效（插件不热重载，桌面端没有刷新按钮）。

人设走的是**常驻系统提示段**（`systemPrompt.section`）：重启后**连已经在跑的会话也立刻生效，不需要新开会话**。

---

## 装 / 卸

**装**（本地 link，不上 npm）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:D:\dsh-her-memory
```

然后重启 DSH。重启后：
- **模型会换上默认人设**（自带的那只鲸鱼女仆）并**称呼你为「主人」** —— 想改就编辑 `人设文件.txt`，想彻底关掉就把它的正文清空（见上面「人设」一节）
- 系统提示里会多一段「你有长期记忆」的说明（固定不变）
- 每轮对话会插一条独立的注入消息（带 `【her-memory｜系统注入，非用户消息】` 前缀，用户自己发的话不会被追加任何东西）

**卸**：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-her-memory
```

再删掉 `~/.dsh/memory/` 就彻底干净了。不留任何残留。

---

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml` 里改）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `memoryRoot` | `~/.dsh/memory` | 记忆目录 |
| `memoryBudget` | `1800` | 每轮注入记忆的字符上限（0 = 不注入） |
| `moodBudget` | `260` | 每轮注入心情的字符上限（0 = 不注入） |
| `injectViaSystemPrompt` | `true` | 是否注入记忆（关掉就只剩心情与工具） |
| `moodDecayHours` | `6` | 每隔几小时心情回落 1 点 |
| `moodGraceHours` | `12` | 多久不聊才开始回落 |
| `statFloor` | `20` | 三个数值的**下限**：再冷落、再累也不会低于它（设 `0` = 恢复可以掉到 0 的旧行为）|
| `statJitter` | `8` | 新对话随机浮动的幅度；**设 `0` = 彻底关掉浮动** |
| `statJitterCooldownMinutes` | `30` | 浮动的时间步长：**离开多久就结算多少次**（隔 3 天 ≈ 补 144 次）|
| `sandboxCwd` | `""` | 隔离工作区路径；留空＝全局共用 |
| `injectFallback` | `false` | ⛔ 兜底注入，别随便开（见下） |
| `personaFile` | `"人设文件.txt"` | 人设正文文件；**文件存在就以它为准**，设 `""` 关闭文件机制 |
| `personaFileAutoWrite` | `true` | 首次运行自动生成人设文件（只写一次，不覆盖已有文件）|
| `persona` | `""` | 兜底人设文本；两处人设文件都不存在时才会用到 |
| `userTitle` | `""` | 人设里的称呼；留空则用「主人」 |

**嫌费 token 就把 `memoryBudget` 调小**，或者把 `injectViaSystemPrompt` 关掉。
调成 0 时该部分完全停止注入。

> ⛔ **`injectFallback` 为什么默认关**：它的做法是在拿不到可改消息时，用 `agent.inject()`
> 另投一条 `role:user` 的注入消息。实测宿主会把这条消息**当成新的用户输入、再跑一整个回合** ——
> 每步投一条就会变成自我维持的**烧钱循环**（用户一句话没说，模型侧连跑好几轮）。
> 除非你清楚代价，否则保持关闭。

---

## 安全性说明

- **零依赖**：不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包。`defineTool` 走动态导入，
  拿不到就用内置降级 —— 所以永远不会往 profile 里拉官方包，
  从根上避开「工具重复注册」那类事故。
- **全量容错**：所有磁盘和 API 失败都被捕获并降级，任何异常都不会抛给宿主，
  最坏情况是记忆功能静默失效，DSH 本身绝对不会加载失败。
- **只读你自己的记忆目录**，不联网，不执行外部命令，不起子进程。
- **卸载即净**：无服务、无端口、无注册表、无计划任务。

---

## 已验证

插件带一整套自动化断言，**每次改动都全部跑一遍才发包**：主测试台 93 项、人设 13 项、
人设文件 21 项、客户端 74 项 —— 覆盖六个工具的读写、工作区隔离、注入方式、心情状态机与界面渲染。

---

## ⚠️ 已知兼容性：与 token-saver 的布局耦合

本插件的状态条与 token-saver 的状态条**在同一列、宽度互相影响** —— 插件会量取 token-saver 状态条的宽度来对齐自己。

- 因此**改动其中任何一条状态条的宽度逻辑，都可能把另一条带歪**：轻则两条宽度错位，重则 token-saver 的「已节省」统计显示异常。
- **遇到了怎么办**：**把 DSH 完全关掉再打开**即可恢复（客户端插件的改动要靠重新加载渲染进程才可见）。实在不行就把两个插件都禁用，再逐个启用排查。
- **没装 token-saver**：量不到参考条，本插件自动退回自己的宽度，不受任何影响。

---

## 更新记录

**1.5.4（2026-10-13）**
- 修复：诊断日志文件（`_apply-hit.txt` 等）被当成「记忆库」，在设置页显示成几个全空卡片
- 诊断日志不再逐条记录 pre-step（纯噪音），统一加了 256KB 上限

**1.5.3（2026-10-13）**
- 默认人设更新（正文 4246 字）：新增「我永远爱着你」「关于闲聊」两节，性格与日常行为两节重排

**1.5.2（2026-10-13）**
- 默认人设升级为完整版（外貌 / 性格详解 / 日常行为 / 相处细节分节）；**老用户的人设不会被覆盖** —— 记忆目录那份优先，删掉它重启才会拿到新的
- 修复注释剥离：人设文件顶部说明块里如果出现 `<!--`、`-->` 字样，后半段说明会被当成正文一起注入

**1.5.1（2026-10-13）**
- 设置页新增「人设文件」快捷入口：显示人设文件真实路径 + 一键用系统默认程序打开（删了会自动补一份；打不开会把路径留在页面上）

**1.5.0（2026-10-13）**
- **三个数值有下限 20 了**：再冷落、再累也不会低于它，不会掉到「什么都不剩」
- **离开多久就结算多少次**：随机浮动从「不管多久只浮动一次」改成**按实际经过的时间结算次数**（每 30 分钟一次）—— 隔三天回来基本就是一个全新状态
- 心情回落拆掉了 30 步封顶，会一路掉到下限 20 为止

**1.4.2（2026-10-13）**
- 修复注入摘要里「说话风格」被长便签挤掉的问题（现在固定排在数值后面，每轮都生效）

**1.4.0（2026-10-13）**
- 双击「心情」「关系」也会随机加 **+0~3**（低值常见）并飘 `+N`；精力仍是 +1~50
- **新对话随机刷新**：隔 30 分钟以上再进来，三个值各自 ±8 轻微浮动
- **设置页多了一个条目**：「新对话随机刷新」的开关，在图形界面里点一下就开/关
- 三个数值现在会影响说话方式（语气、篇幅、亲密度都跟着走）

**1.3.0（2026-10-13）**
- 状态条支持双击：双击「心情」「关系」冒对应颜色的泡泡；双击「精力」随机回血 +1~50（低值常见、高值稀有）并飘一个 `+NN`
- 特效走独立浮层，不影响状态条宽度与布局

**1.2.0（2026-10-13）**
- 改人设不再需要碰配置文件：人设正文现在是一个独立的 `人设文件.txt`，直接编辑即可 —— 不用管缩进，写错也不影响启动
- 人设文件有两处：记忆目录里那份（优先生效、重装不丢，推荐改它）与插件目录里那份（随包默认值，首次运行复制过去）
- 正文清空 = 关闭人设；删掉文件 = 恢复默认；新增配置项 `personaFile` / `personaFileAutoWrite`

**1.1.2（2026-10-13）**
- 修复状态条右侧的轮数 / 记忆条数显示在底板外面的问题 —— 现在底板永远包住内容
- 调整默认人设「活人感」一段的表述

**1.1.1（2026-10-13）**
- 精力会自己恢复了：放下 30 分钟起按每 30 分钟 +5，空着 8 小时以上直接回满

**1.1.0（2026-10-08）**
- 注入方式重做：你自己发的那条消息不再被追加任何东西，保持原样
- 人设 / 记忆说明 / 硬要求改为常驻系统提示，不再每轮重复消耗 token
- 工作区隔离改为配置项 `sandboxCwd`；包名统一为 `dsh-her-memory`

更早的版本见 **`更新日志.md`**。

plugins.description: 备案公示检查：查应用里有没有 ICP/APP 备案号、隐私政策入口、运营者信息。
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-filing

**备案公示检查** —— 查应用里有没有 ICP 备案号、APP 备案号、隐私政策入口、运营者信息。

## 不装它会怎样

你的网站/App 上线了，功能没问题，但**页脚只有一行 `© 2026 Demo Project`**。

检查来了，问的第一个问题是：**「备案号呢？」**

```
《互联网信息服务管理办法》第十二条
  —— 应在网站主页面标明备案编号

工信部信管〔2023〕105号
  —— 2023 年起 APP 也需要单独备案（以前只有网站要）

《个人信息保护法》第十七条
  —— 应以显著方式告知；「未公开收集使用规则」是明确的违规行为
```

**这些都是可以提前自查的**，而不是等被通知整改。

## 关键词
**关键词**：ICP备案 · APP备案 · 应用备案 · 备案号 · 备案编号 · 隐私政策 · 用户协议 · 运营者信息
**Keywords**: ICP filing · app filing · filing number · privacy policy · China compliance

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 找不到 ICP 备案号 · APP 备案号 · 隐私政策入口 |
| 🟡 中 | 找不到运营者主体信息 |

## 一条规则是「条件适用」的

**`FILING-NO-APP` 只在检测到移动端项目时运行**（识别标志：uniapp / react-native / flutter / AndroidManifest…）。

纯 Web 项目跑这条就是误报 —— 这一条我们踩过。不适用时会在报告里记为「未运行」，**不算已检查**（防止假绿）。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-filing
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-filing
```

![dsh-cn-filing 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-filing/report.png)

![dsh-cn-filing 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-filing/demo.png)

![dsh-cn-filing 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-filing/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-cn-filing --demo
dsh-cn-filing --list-rules
dsh-cn-filing --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **只查「有没有写」，不查「备案是否真实有效」** —— 备案号的真伪要去工信部系统查，本工具不联网。
- **不覆盖小程序备案**（也有单独要求），识别标志可能不全。
- **absence 类规则是弱信号** —— 备案信息可能由部署层/模板统一渲染，不从仓库代码走。
  报出来是**提示你确认**，不是判定。
- **格式校验有限** —— 能识别 `ICP备` / `APP备案` 等关键词，但不严格校验号码格式。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**


---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 22 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [**备案公示**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）和 npm 上，`dsh plugin --profile web add <包名>` 即可安装。
