plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chess-board

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-chess-board.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-chess-board)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](#许可)

**在 DSH 里下国际象棋。** 右侧边栏里的一个棋盘标签页——和文件树、终端平级，还能拖出来变成浮窗。

| 能做什么 | |
|---|---|
| **完整规则** | 王车易位（含"不能穿过被攻击格""被将时不能易位"）、吃过路兵、兵升变、将死/逼和、五十步和棋；perft 与公开参考值逐项一致 |
| **八档内置对手** | 档位编号与 lichess 一致（`Level 1…8`），由「搜索深度 + 可接受着法带宽 + 失误率」共同决定，不是只调深度 |
| **lichess 云端评估** | 每个局面自动查 cloud-eval：优势条 + 一句话结论 + 带回合数的线路。被限流时改用本地引擎兜底，并**标注来源** |
| **复盘与战术题** | 导入自己的对局或任意 PGN 逐步复盘、从任意局面接着下（Practice）、每日/随机战术题 |
| **和 lichess 引擎下棋** | 贴一个 token 即可开一局；引擎应手**由服务器推送**回来（不是轮询），可认输/求和/中止 |
| **手感** | 点两步或**直接拖**棋子；落子有滑行动画；中英双语 + 设置页 |

## 快速开始

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-chess-board
```

安装后**重启 DSH**（bundle 列表只在宿主启动时组装一次），然后在右侧边栏标签条的「添加」控件里选 **Chess**。

> **不登录也能用**：云端评估、残局库、PGN 回放、战术题都不需要账号。
> 只有「与 lichess 引擎对局」需要 token——账号页会给一个**已勾好所需权限**的建 token 链接。

## 界面位置

棋盘不是一个浮层，而是右侧边栏（编辑区旁边那一列）的一个标签页，与文件树、终端等平级：

- 标签类型通过 `ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register({ id, kind, priority: 'extension', title, guide })` 注册，
  正文与 chip 标题分别注册到 `sidebar.right.pane.tab` 与 `sidebar.right.pane.tab.title`（用类型的 `id` 作 key）。
- **打开方式**：
  1. 边栏标签条上的"添加"控件 → 引导页里的 **Chess** 卡片；
  2. 会话里文件/链接旁的侧栏入口。
- **右下角角标只在一种情况下出现**：**棋盘开着、但没显示出来**（典型是收起右侧栏）。
  它是**召回按钮，不是入口**——没有棋盘开着时它不占位置，因为标签条自己就能开一个。

  | 状态 | 正文 | 角标 |
  |---|---|---|
  | 没开过 / 标签页已关闭 | 未挂载 | **不渲染** |
  | 标签页开着、面板可见 | 挂载且可见 | **不渲染** |
  | **侧栏收起（开着但不可见）** | **仍然挂载** | **显示** |

  启动器是固定浮层条目，看不到侧栏的标签状态，所以由标签页正文自己上报，上报两个轴：
  **是否挂载**（= 标签页是否开着）与**是否在屏幕上**。

  > "开着但不可见"这种状态是**实测出来的，不是推断的**：DSH 侧栏自己的注释写着
  > docked content "stays mounted while collapsed, translated off the frame's right edge"，
  > 我也在真机上验证过——收起侧栏后正文**并没有卸载**。所以判定用 `IntersectionObserver`
  > 观测正文容器是否真的与视口相交（被移出视口 ⇒ 不相交）。
  >
  > 点击角标走的是侧栏的**打开标签页**路径，其文档写明会 "claim it, place it, **reveal the column**"，
  > 因此它会展开收起的侧栏并聚焦已存在的 Chess 标签页。
  >
  > 存的是**实例列表**而不是计数器：分栏里可以同时有两个 Chess 标签页，
  > 而"一个被隐藏、另一个还开着"这种不成对的增减会把计数永久带偏。
  >
  > `harness.mjs` 里加了一个**可控的假 `IntersectionObserver`** 与最小 ref 支持，
  > 因此上表三个状态都是被断言的（含"隐藏时角标内联定位为 fixed / 右下 16px"，
  > 以及点击确实发出揭示请求）。

### 拖拽

拖拽能力来自 DSH 的停靠系统（dockkit），标签页类型注册好就自动具备，**插件不需要也不能自己实现**：

| 操作 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 拖标签胶囊左右移动 | 在同栏内换位 |
| 拖到分栏边缘 | 与该格并排分栏（最多两格） |
| **把标签拖出边栏** | 变成**浮窗**，可拖到屏幕上任意位置、可改尺寸 |
| 浮窗右键菜单 → 收回到侧边栏 | 重新停靠 |

标签页正文的 `tabActions` 只暴露 `{bindCommands, openResource, openTab, close}`——浮出与移动是停靠条的手势，
所以正文里没有、也不该有拖拽代码；反过来说，正文只要不吞指针事件，拖拽就不会被破坏。

> **正文确实注册了 `pointerdown` 了**（拖动棋子），但只在**棋盘**上：停靠手势的抓取点是标签条上的胶囊，
> 那里没有任何本插件的处理器。棋盘自己的 `touch-action:none` / `user-select:none` 也只作用于棋盘那一块。

## 功能

### 对局（本地）

- **两种走子手势**：点一下棋子再点目标格，**或者直接把棋子拖过去**。
- **完整规则**：合法着法判定、将军/将死/逼和、王车易位（含"不能穿过被攻击格""被将时不能易位"）、吃过路兵、兵升变（可选后/车/象/马）、五十步和棋。
- **对手**：内置 alpha-beta 搜索 + 子力位置表，**八档难度 `Level 1…Level 8`（与 lichess 同一套编号）**；同一档位也是创建 lichess 对局时发给它的 `level`。
- **操作**：点选棋子 → 点目标格；可选执白/执黑；悔棋（**一次退回一整个回合**，见下）；翻转棋盘；SAN 着法记录。

> **悔棋语义**：内置对手会应手，所以"最后一步"其实包含两着（你的 + 引擎的）。
> 只退一着等于把棋交回给引擎，它会立刻再应一手——用户永远收不回自己的棋。
> 现在悔棋会**一直退到"上一次轮到你走"的局面**，把引擎的应手和你自己的着法一起收回；
> 执黑时同理（引擎先走的那一着不算在你的回合里）。

### 界面取舍

边栏很窄、面板要在竖向空间里放下棋盘 + 分析 + 着法，所以有几处刻意的决定：

| 决定 | 理由 |
|---|---|
| **棋盘用熟悉的棕色木色**（`#f0d9b5` / `#b58863`） | 一眼就认得出是棋盘。这是插件里**唯一**的字面色：它和棋子字形一样属于"美术"，浅色/深色模式下都一样，因为木色棋盘就是木色 |
| 坐标**画在格子内部**，取**对面格的底色** | 这样坐标在深浅两种格子上都清晰，并且归属它标注的那一格 |
| 上一步与选中是**淡绿色水洗**，不是描边环 | 玩家熟悉的约定；水洗块不会盖住棋子轮廓，也不会和选中态抢视觉 |
| 可走点是**半透明墨绿圆点**，吃子是**圆环** | 同上，可走点与吃子目标必须一眼可分 |
| 被将的国王是**红色径向光晕**（画在棋子下面） | 光晕不会压住国王字形 |
| 白子/黑子用**同一枚实心字形 + 对比描边**做双色 | 空心字形无法被 `color` 填充，之前`color` 对两侧相同，木色棋盘上白黑几乎分不出。现在是白底深描、深底浅描 |
| 棋格是**尺寸容器**，棋子填满格（`width/height:100%`） | 矢量棋子任意尺寸都清晰；`cqw` 留给可走点的圆环用 |
| 落子有**滑行动画**（190ms） | 见下面"棋子怎么滑过去" |
| 棋盘 `max-width:min(100%,520px)` 且居中 | 宽栏里一个 600px 的方块会迫使先滚动才能看到别的东西 |
| 棋盘上下各一条**玩家栏**（对手在上、你在下） | 一局棋的读法；复盘时显示 PGN 里的双方名字 |
| 控件按**带标签的组**排布（`Play as`、`Level`），操作按钮单独一行 | 一排光秃秃的 `White / Black`、`Easy / Normal / Hard` 要用户猜它属于什么；用弹簧把 `Flip`、`Undo` 推到最远右侧，会让控件离开它所作用的棋局 |
| 难度用 **lichess 的 1–8 编号**（`Level 1…Level 8`），且**同一个数字也发给 lichess** | 一处设定只该有一个含义：本地对手和 lichess 引擎用同一档，不必在两套刻度之间换算。**中文里显示"3 级"**：档位名走 `levelLabel()`，因为下拉框的选项文字没法事后替换 |
| 八档用**下拉框**而不是分段控件 | 48px 标签列旁边塞 8 个按钮在窄栏里挤成一团；lichess 自己也是把档位收在滑杆后面 |
| 档位由 **深度 + 可接受着法带宽 + 失误率**共同决定，不是只调深度 | 1 层搜索但永远走最优解，下起来仍然像机器；`blunder` 才是"像初学者"的那一半 |
| 分析里的主变显示 **SAN**（`e4 e5 Nf3`），不是 lichess 发来的 **UCI**（`e2e4 e7e5 g1f3`） | UCI 是机器记法，没人这样读棋；把着法序列在棋盘上重放一遍就得到带消歧义与将军标记的 SAN |
| 评估给的是**优势条 + 一句话结论**，线路带回合数、备选标出差距 | 见下面"引擎分析这一块怎么读" |
| 去掉行话：`cloud depth 75 · cached` → `lichess cloud · depth 75`；`no stored line` → "lichess has no stored evaluation for this position" | 界面上的字应该是不懂引擎的人也能读的 |
| 每步只在一处说"该谁走" | 状态行已经说了，玩家栏再说一次就是噪音 |
| 面板内四个视图用**分段控件**，不是第二条标签条 | 边栏标签页上方已经有一条标签条，再来一排胶囊是要用户解码的多余 chrome |
| 标签页形态下**不画标题行** | 停靠条已经画了这个标签的胶囊和关闭键，正文里再写一次"♞ Chess"是重复 |
| 升变选择器**浮在棋盘上** | 升变是棋盘上的动作；整窗遮罩在边栏里还会把会话一起遮黑 |
| 棋盘以外的一切（按钮、分段控件、边框）走宿主主题 token | 插件是宿主界面的一部分；只有棋盘是作品 |

### 拖动棋子

按下棋子就**立刻选中它**（合法目标的圆点马上出现），再拖到目标格松手即走子。要点：

| 决定 | 为什么 |
|---|---|
| 手势挂在**棋盘**上，不是格子上；并**捕获指针** | 挂在格子上会在跨过间隙时丢事件；不捕获则指针移出棋盘后松手，拖拽会**卡住不结束** |
| 目标格用 `data-square` **反查**，不量像素 | 捕获指针后 `event.target` 永远是棋盘，所以必须自己命中测试；`document.elementFromPoint` 只查那个本来就有的属性，**不做任何布局测量**（测试里也就能用一个 DOM 桩驱动整个拖拽） |
| 位移**小于 4px 就当点击** | 保持点击走子原样可用：手按下时抖一下，不该变成"从原格拖到原格"的拖拽 |
| 松手在**原格**也走点击路径 | 那条路径才知道选中/取消选中/升变该怎么处理 |
| 松手落到非法格 → **什么都不做**，棋子回位 | 玩家熟悉的取消语义；不改变原有选中状态 |
| 拖动中的棋子用**像素**偏移（`translate`） | 棋盘上唯一一处不是"以格为单位"的量——它跟的是指针，不是格子 |
| 目标格给**绿框 / 深色框**反馈 | 拖拽里唯一的"会落在哪"的信号 |
| 棋盘 `touch-action:none` | 否则在触屏上拖棋子会变成滚面板 |
| 与停靠拖拽**不冲突** | 停靠手势的抓取点是标签条胶囊，棋盘上没有本插件的处理器（见上面"拖拽"一节） |


棋盘是**一格一个元素**，所以"e2 到 e4"在 DOM 里其实是"这里少一个棋子、那里多一个棋子"。动画就是把
**到达那一格**的棋子先摆回它来的位置，再让它滑回原位：

```
--dshFromX / --dshFromY   ← 起点偏移，单位是"它自己那一格"（一格 = 100%）
@keyframes dshChessSlide  ← from: translate(起点) → to: transform:none
```

| 决定 | 为什么 |
|---|---|
| 偏移用**自身格子的百分比**，不用像素 | 棋子填满格子，所以"横走一格"就正好是 `100%`。**从不需要测量**，任何面板宽度、任何缩放、任何棋盘尺寸下数字都成立 |
| 起点由 `move.castle` 补齐**第二个棋子** | 王车易位的车也在动。只动王的话，车就是瞬移的 |
| 到达格整体抬到 `z-index:2` | 格子是 `container-type:size`，也就是**布局包含 = 独立层叠上下文**——抬棋子本身**抬不出它自己的格子**，滑行途中会被经过的格子盖住。要抬的是格子 |
| 给棋子一个**跟着着法变化的 `key`** | React 会复用目标格的元素（吃子只是换内容），而 CSS 动画不会因为"类名本来就在"而重播；换 key 才会重新挂载 |
| "这个着法要动画"的判断**粘住**，不是一次性的 | 一次性判断的后果不是"少播一次"：下一次渲染（350ms 后的云端评估）会同时丢掉元素的 key，**把滑到一半的棋子重新挂载、动画当场截断** |
| 面板刚出现时**不播**（`mounted` 标志） | 打开标签页看到的是"上一步"的残留，不该假装那一步刚刚发生 |
| 设置里可以关（默认开），并**遵循系统"减少动画"** | `@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)` 直接关掉；没必要让人因为一个棋盘而晕 |

> `harness.mjs` 没有 CSS 引擎，所以两侧分工：**动画本身**（keyframes、起点变量、reduce-motion）在
> `verify-bundle.mjs` 里对落地样式表断言；**哪个棋子在动、动的偏移是多少**在 harness 里断言——
> 包括 e2e4 是 `0%/200%`、翻面后变成 `0%/-200%`、王车易位是**两个**棋子（`-200%/0%` 与 `200%/0%`）、
> 以及关掉设置后一个都不动。



面板顶部那块评估曾经是"一个数字 + 三行光秃秃的着法"，读起来像谜题。现在它回答三个问题：

```
引擎分析                  ← 这一块是什么：lichess 云端 · 深度 75 · 已缓存
[优势条]  +0.27 · 白方略优   ← 这个数字对谁有利、有多大
最佳   1. c4 dxc4 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. e3 c5
备选   1. Nf3 e6 2. c4 Nf6 3. Nc3 Bb4     −0.11
备选   1. e3 Nf6 2. c4 e6 2. Nf3 Be7      −0.18
```

| 改动 | 为什么 |
|---|---|
| 加了**标题**（"引擎分析"）与来源/深度 | 三行着法不会自己说它是谁给的、有多可信 |
| 优势画成**条 + 一句话** | `+0.27` 本身不是答案；条回答"偏向谁、偏多少"，句子回答"算大吗" |
| 着法**带回合数**（`1. c4 dxc4 2. Nf3`） | 光秃秃一串着法读不出轮到谁、也没有谱的节奏；带编号就读得像棋谱 |
| 备选行显示**与最佳线的差距**（`−0.11`） | 三个绝对分数要心算才能比较；差距直接说明"这条差多少"，这才是选择 |
| 每一行的**自身分数**放进 tooltip | 需要时能拿到，但不再有第二个数字抢注意力 |
| 崩溃/无评估/查询中各自有**独立文案** | "没有存档评估"和"连不上 lichess"是两件事 |
| **刷新失败不清空优势条** | 见下面"限流与优势条" |

### 限流与优势条

真机上出现过"优势条显示不出来"，界面上只有一句 `无法连接 lichess: too many requests to lichess`。
根因不是渲染，而是**被 lichess 限流（429）**，并且当时有两处把它们叠加成了"永远看不到条"：

| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 宿主对 429 **没有退避**：每换一个局面立刻再打一次 → 又被拒 → 限流一直续着 | 收到 429 就进入**冷却**（优先用 `Retry-After`，否则 2s → 5s → 15s → 30s 递增），冷却期内**直接本地拒绝、不发请求**；任何一次成功都清零 |
| 冷却会把**用户主动的操作**（走子、发起对局）也挡住 | 冷却只作用于**可选的查询**（`cloudEval` / `tablebase`），走子等照常发出 |
| 面板出错时把整块分析（含优势条）换成一行警告 | **同局面的刷新失败不再清空已有评估**：条留着，原因写在下面一行（`title` 里保留原始信息） |
| 请求开始时 `setCloud({loading:true})` 会**覆盖**上一次的好结果，于是失败时已经没东西可留 | 同局面的重载保留旧结果，只是标记 `loading`；只有"什么都没有"时才显示"正在查询" |
| 每次局面变化都请求（350ms 防抖） | 防抖提到 **600ms**；另外**被拒过的局面在宿主缓存里 5 分钟内不会再问** |
| 云端**完全没结果**时（新开的棋盘 + 限流）没有条可留 | **本地引擎兜底**：用内置浅搜（深度 3）给出分数与一手建议，并明确标注来源是"本地引擎"而不是 lichess |

限流的文案也单独一条（`analysis.rateLimited`）："限制频率，稍后自动恢复"和"连不上 l

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器与插件——读已有配置而非要求作者重新移植，并明确报告哪些能跑、哪些缺密钥、哪些跑不了。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-babel **让 DSH 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器、插件与斜杠命令。** > 读它们已有的配置，而不是要求插件作者为 DSH 重新移植一遍。 [![简体中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-%E7%AE%80%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-red.svg)](README.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-English-blue.svg)](README.en.md) [![test](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2EA44F?style=flat)](LICENSE) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel?style=flat&label=%E2%98%85)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![dsh-plugin topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2563eb.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
> dsh-babel 是社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，并非 DeepSeek AI 官方产品。 ## 它解决什么问题 插件作者要支持一个平台，就得为它单独写一份目录。一个典型的多平台插件会带六到八个这样的目录： ``` .claude-plugin .codex-plugin .cursor .gemini-extension.json ... ``` DSH 的那个格子通常是空的。dsh-babel 换个思路：**作者不用动，DSH 这边读他们已有的 `.mcp.json` / `commands/`**，把 N×M 的移植问题变成 N×1。 同时它做一件别家没做的事：**装之前就告诉你哪个能跑、哪个缺密钥、哪个根本跑不起来**——而不是装上去之后静默失败。 ## 功能 - **发现**：扫描 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件目录下的 `.mcp.json`，以及两种斜杠命令文件（`.md` / `.toml`）；根目录可配置。 - **归一化**：把多种 `.mcp.json` 方言（带 `mcpServers` 包装的 / 裸顶层的 / Codex 专有键的）降成**一套中间表示**。 - **预检**：四类检查把"静默失败"变成"明确原因"——依赖命令是否在 `PATH`、守护进程是否在跑（如 Docker socket）、密钥是否可用、版本是否未固定。 - **兼容性报告**：把每个服务器归入「可用 / 需密钥 / 不可用」，每条都附具体原因。 - **命令注册**：把发现到的斜杠命令注册进 DSH，支持 `{{args}}` / `$ARGUMENTS` / `$1` 参数替换。 - **MCP 注册**：连上 stdio 或 streamable-http 服务器，用 DSH 自己的 `createMcpToolDefinition` 注册工具。 - **密钥解析**：`process.env` 优先，其次 macOS 钥匙串的**白名单**（仅 GitHub token 家族）——绝不无差别翻钥匙串。 - **展示元数据**：`locale/` 文案与图标，配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，设置界面可渲染。 ## 安装 ```bash # 从 GitHub plugin_manager install_bundle github:Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel # 或本地目录 plugin_manager install_bundle /绝对/路径/dsh-babel ``` 也可以在 DSH Desktop 里走 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填入仓库地址或本地路径。 安装后默认 **dry-run**：只在日志里打印兼容性报告，**不注册任何东西**。 ## 配置 配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，因此会出现在 **设置 → 插件 → dsh-babel** 的配置界面里： | 配置项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `roots` | `[]` | 扫描根目录；字符串路径或 `{ source, path }`。留空时使用默认的 Claude / Codex 插件目录 | | `dryRun` | `true` | 只报告，不注册。要真正注册必须先设为 `false` | | `logReport` | `true` | 把兼容性报告打印到日志 | | `registerCommands` | `false` | 注册发现到的斜杠命令（需 `dryRun: false`） | | `registerMcp` | `false` | 注册预检通过（`severity: ok`）的 MCP 服务器（需 `dryRun: false`） | 开启真注册： ```yaml config: dryRun: false registerCommands: true registerMcp: true ``` ## 兼容矩阵（诚实版） | 外部形态 | 覆盖 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | MCP `.mcp.json`（stdio） | ✅ 高 | 免密钥、依赖命令存在的，基本可用 | | MCP `.mcp.json`（http/sse） | ✅ 高 | 依赖 bearer token 的会标「需密钥」 | | MCP（依赖宿主运行时变量） | ⚠️ 有损 | `CODEX_*` / `CLAUDE_*` 等对方宿主注入的变量，DSH 没有，标为不可用 | | MCP（OAuth） | ❌ 无对应 | `oauth_resource` 等 DSH 无等价物，丢弃并告知 | | 技能 `skills/*/SKILL.md` | ✅ 高 | 格式统一（由 skills-manager 等已有实现覆盖） | | 斜杠命令 `commands/*` | ✅ 已实现 | 发现 + 归一化 + 报告 + 注册 | | Hooks | ⚠️ 有损 | DSH 仅 7 个点、仅 command handler | | 子代理 `agents/*` | ⚠️ 降级 | DSH 无注册接口，只能降级为技能 | | 插件 UI / mods | ❌ 不支持 | 必须用 DSH client 插件重写，无法移植 | ## 报告长什么样 在一台装了 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件的机器上，首次加载会打印： ``` === dsh-babel 兼容性报告 === 文件: 28 服务器: 28 方言: {"bare":14,"wrapped":14} 传输: {"stdio":17,"streamable-http":11} 结论: 可用 14 / 需密钥 5 / 不可用 9 ✗ 不可用 (9): laravel-boost [stdio] BLOCKED - [command] command not on PATH: php terraform [stdio] BLOCKED - [daemon] docker installed but not running (no socket / probe failed) - [secret] missing credential: TFE_TOKEN codex_app [stdio] BLOCKED - [env] depends on CODEX_MCP_NODE_PATH (other-harness runtime), not available in DSH ``` 这就是这个插件的第二个价值：**明确告诉你为什么跑不起来**，而不是让用户以为「DSH 很烂」。 ## 目录结构 ``` index.js 插件入口（apply + schemastery Config，Cordis 宿主插件形式） cordis.patch.yml bundle patch（插入 dsh-babel 一行） locale/zh.json 卡片展示文案（标题 + 简介） locale/en.json same, in English icon.svg 插件图标 lib/normalize.mjs 内核：方言 → IR lib/discover.mjs 发现：遍历文件系统找声明 lib/preflight.mjs 预检：命令 / daemon / 密钥 / 版本 lib/secrets.mjs 密钥解析：env 为主 + 钥匙串白名单兜底 lib/commands.mjs 命令归一化：.md / .toml → 命令 IR lib/register.mjs 命令注册：ctx.commands.register + 参数替换 lib/register-mcp.mjs MCP 注册：连接 + createMcpToolDefinition + 工具注册 lib/report.mjs 报告：聚合 + 文本渲染 bin/dsh-babel.mjs CLI runner（本地测试用） test/ 单测 + 冒烟 docs/ 详细文档 CHANGELOG.md 版本变更记录 ``` ## 开发与测试 ```bash npm test # 全部单测（75 断言） node test/mcp-smoke.mjs # MCP 注册冒烟（需本地 symlink 到 DSH 包 + 真实服务器） node bin/dsh-babel.mjs # 直接跑一次报告 ``` ## 文档 - [功能详解](docs/FEATURES.md) - [配置参考](docs/CONFIG.md) - [兼容性说明](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) - [架构与中间表示](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [版本变更](CHANGELOG.md) ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Deep Feishu / Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness: Bitable (multidimensional tables), docs, sheets, wiki, drive, messages, plus a visual settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-feishu

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Deep **Feishu / Lark** integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

It gives the agent eight tools that act on a real Feishu tenant (and a browser
panel that shows what it did and fixes authorization in one click):

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `feishu_bitable` | Create **Bitable (多维表格)** apps with their tables and fields in one call; list tables and fields; insert, search, update, and delete records in batches |
| `feishu_dashboard` | Create dashboards and **chart blocks** inside a Bitable (柱状图 / 折线图 / 饼图 / 排行榜 / 指标卡 / NPS … 15 types), position them, and read a chart's computed numbers |
| `feishu_query` | Run a **grouped, aggregated query** over a table (group by, sum / avg / min / max / count / distinct_count, filter, sort, top-N) with the aggregation done server-side |
| `feishu_doc` | Create documents; append Markdown (converted to native blocks), append raw blocks, read plain text, or import a local Markdown/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF file as a new cloud document |
| `feishu_sheet` | Create spreadsheets; add sheets; read, write, and append ranges |
| `feishu_drive` | Browse folders, create folders, upload and download files, move, delete, read metadata |
| `feishu_wiki` | List wiki spaces and nodes, resolve a wiki token to its document, create and move nodes |
| `feishu_message` | Send text, interactive cards, rich posts, files, and images; reply in a thread; post through a custom-bot webhook |
| `feishu_auth` | Diagnose authorization, produce the authorization URL, complete a manual code exchange, refresh, and log out |
| `feishu_api` | Call any documented Feishu open-platform path, with the same auth, retry, and error mapping |

New content lands in **the user's own cloud drive** because the tools act as the
authorized user, not as the app. When no user grant is stored they fall back to
the app identity and say so in a warning rather than silently filing documents
into a space the user cannot see.

---

## Quick start

### 1. Create a Feishu app

1. Open the [Feishu Open Platform](https://open.feishu.cn/app) (or
   [Lark](https://open.larksuite.com/app)) and create a **custom app**.
2. Under **凭证与基础信息**, note the **App ID** and **App Secret**.
3. Under **安全设置 → 重定向 URL**, add the callback this plugin serves:

   ```
   http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/feishu/oauth/callback
   ```

   The port is whatever DeepSeek Harness serves on (the plugin reads it from the
   host and reports the exact URI in `feishu_auth` action `status`).
4. Under **权限管理**, add the scopes below, then **publish a version** — scopes
   only apply after the version is released:

   | Scope | Needed for |
   |---|---|
   | `offline_access` | **Required** — without it Feishu returns no refresh token and the user must re-authorize every couple of hours |
   | `bitable:app` | Bitable |
   | `docx:document` | Documents |
   | `drive:drive` | Drive, imports, uploads |
   | `sheets:spreadsheet` | Spreadsheets |
   | `wiki:wiki` | Wiki |
   | `im:message`, `im:resource` | Messages and file/image sending |
   | `contact:user.base:readonly` | Reading the authorized user's name |

### 2. Enable the plugin

See [Install](#install) below, then restart DeepSeek Harness.

### 3. Configure it in the GUI

Open **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu**. Everything is editable there — no YAML by hand:

- **应用凭据** — the App ID, the App Secret (write-only), the credential
  reference name, and the brand (飞书 / Lark).
- **默认落点与身份** — the folder new content lands in, and which identity the
  tools use by default.
- **功能开关** — whether the tools register, whether the HTTP routes mount,
  whether the floating panel shows, and the tool-name prefix.
- **授权** — the scopes to request and the redirect URL to register.
- **高级** — endpoint overrides and the page-size caps.

**Saving writes only this plugin's entry** in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`,
which the harness hot-reloads, so most changes apply without a restart. The App
Secret is *never* written to that file: it goes straight into the credential
store under the reference name, and the page only ever shows whether it is set.

### 4. Authorize

Press **授权飞书** on the settings page, or ask the agent to run `feishu_auth`
with action `authorize_url`. The browser lands on the callback, the grant is
stored, and every later call acts as that user. The same form shows the redirect
URL to register on the Feishu app and lists the scopes to grant.

> Host without a reachable browser callback (a remote or headless session)? Open
> the URL anywhere, then pass the `code` query parameter to `feishu_auth` with
> action `complete`.

---

## Install

Two ways, and they are alternatives — **do not do both.** Each creates a loader
entry with id `feishu`, and the loader rejects a composition that defines one id
twice with `duplicate loader entry id`.

### As a bundle (recommended)

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so a bundle-aware CLI installs and
mounts it in one step:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:2048lr/dsh-feishu
```

That appends `dsh-feishu` to `dsh.profile.bundles` and profile boot merges
[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml), which inserts the plugin row. Nothing else
needs editing.

The settings page is aware of this: when the profile mounts the bundle, it writes
an **id-targeted config override** rather than a second `insert`, so saving from
the GUI never breaks the composition.

### By hand (no CLI)

The plugin must be resolvable from the profile's `node_modules`, so it is copied
there:

```powershell
# from the repository root
pwsh -File scripts/install.ps1
```

The script copies the package into the profile's `node_modules` and inserts the
entry into `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: feishu
      name: dsh-feishu
      config:
        appId: cli_xxxxxxxxxxxx
        # appSecretRef: FEISHU_APP_SECRET
        # brand: feishu          # or lark
        # defaultFolderToken: fldcnxxxxxxxx
```

**Restart DeepSeek Harness.** The host half is a Node module cached in-process,
so a reload alone does not pick it up. The browser half reloads with the page.

After that first restart, use **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu** instead of editing the YAML:
the page rewrites the block the installer added and the harness hot-reloads it.

### Why the package avoids `@deepseek-ai/*` imports

A third-party plugin is loaded from a junction or a copied directory inside the
profile, where a bare `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` specifier resolves to whichever
DSH installation is reachable — which may not be the running host. The host half
therefore imports **only Node builtins** and hand-writes its tool definitions
and its configuration validation. The test suite checks every generated schema
against the real SDK validator, so the hand-written form cannot drift from what
the registry accepts.

---

## Configuration

All fields are optional except `appId`.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `appId` | — | The Feishu app id. Required. |
| `appSecretRef` | `FEISHU_APP_SECRET` | Credential reference resolved through the harness credential store, then the environment. |
| `appSecret` | `''` | Literal fallback. Discouraged: it puts a secret in configuration. |
| `brand` | `feishu` | `feishu` (open.feishu.cn) or `lark` (open.larksuite.com). |
| `apiBaseUrl` / `accountsBaseUrl` | per brand | Override the endpoints (for a proxy or a private gateway). |
| `defaultFolderToken` | `''` | Where new documents, sheets, Bitable apps, and uploads go when a call omits a folder. |
| `defaultIdentity` | `auto` | `auto`, `user`, or `app`. `auto` uses the user when authorized and otherwise the app, reporting the fallback. |
| `toolPrefix` | `feishu_` | Rename the tools (for example `fs_`). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-attempt timeout. |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | Total attempts for rate-limited or transient failures (capped at 6). |
| `enableTools` | `true` | Register the model-facing tools. |
| `enableOAuth` | `true` | Mount the `/api/feishu/*` routes (status, activity, config, OAuth). |
| `enableUi` | `true` | Show the floating panel. |
| `oauthRedirectUri` | auto | Override the callback. Empty means "use

plugins.description: Claude Code visual theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI ??warm paper palette, terracotta accent, Claude Code transcript markers and mono-forward typography.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-claude-code-theme **Claude Desktop's visual language for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.** Warm paper neutrals, terracotta accent, readable prose, quiet layered surfaces and a continuous composer — applied through DSH's own theme extension point, not by patching its stylesheets. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-code-theme) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](./LICENSE)
## Before and after Stock DSH — right-aligned bubble on a blue-tinted canvas, soft 12–28px corners, a floating composer with a circular send button: With the theme — a deeper sidebar, a raised right-hand panel, prose set for reading, compact tool summaries, and a continuous composer: Light mode, on Claude's cream canvas with white raised sheets: --- ## Install ```sh dsh plugin install dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Or add the row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and its package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`: ```yaml - insert: - id: claude-code-theme name: dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Reload the Web GUI. There is nothing to switch on: the theme composes over whichever palette you already use, so `light`, `dark` and `system` all keep working. ## What changes **Colour.** DSH's design system has three token tiers, and the theme works on all three: | Tier | What it is | What the theme does | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-static-*` | The raw colour ramps | Retints DSH's blue-tinted greys to Claude's warm paper greys, and DeepSeek blue to terracotta. The alias tier resolves through these, so this alone recolours most of the application. | | `--dsw-alias-*` | The semantic roles components consume | Pins the roles Claude treats differently: a cream canvas under raised sheets, a terracotta primary button and focus ring, warm hairlines, and text that stops short of pure white on dark. | | `--dsw-specific-*` | Named surfaces | Retunes the sidebar, composer, bubbles, menus and code surfaces. | **Surface hierarchy.** Claude Desktop stacks depth rather than flattening it, so the theme gives each column its own level instead of one shared grey: | Region | Dark | Light | | --- | --- | --- | | Sidebar | `#111110` (deepest) | `#f5f3ec` | | Canvas | `#171716` | `#faf9f5` | | Raised sheets — cards, composer, right panel | `#1d1d1b` | `#ffffff` | The right panel becomes a raised sheet separated by a hairline instead of floating as a detached card. **Geometry.** DSH routes **280 `border-radius` declarations through six `--dsw-radius-*` tokens** (measured across all 179 shipped UI bundles), so the theme re-points the scale itself: | Token | DSH | Theme | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-radius-xs` | 4px | 4px | | `--dsw-radius-sm` | 8px | 6px | | `--dsw-radius-md` | 12px | 8px | | `--dsw-radius-lg` | 16px | 12px | | `--dsw-radius-xl` | 20px | 16px | | `--dsw-radius-panel` | 28px | 20px | The corners that bypass the scale are reached through the stable `data-slot` and `data-*` hooks rather than a build hash. **Typography.** This is the part that most decides whether the result reads as a product or as a costume. Claude Desktop is a reading surface, so the transcript is set in the UI sans at a comfortable line height, and monospace is kept for the things that are actually code: | | Treatment | | --- | --- | | Assistant prose | UI sans, 1.65 line height, normal heading letter-spacing | | Inline code, code blocks, tool output | Monospace | | Sidebar, header, composer | UI sans | | Code-block banner | Sentence case, not shouted uppercase | **Transcript.** Your turn is a right-aligned bubble on a quiet surface; the assistant's is prose on the canvas; tool calls collapse into single-line summaries (`Ran 2 commands ›`) that expand in place, which is how Claude Desktop keeps a long working session scannable. **Composer.** One continuous rounded surface: the editor and the controls share a single card with no divider between them, the submit control is a circle, and focus draws a soft terracotta ring rather than a hard outline. **Chrome.** Quiet navigation rows instead of an elevated primary button, hover states limited to enabled controls, `focus-visible` rings for keyboard use, and thin warm scrollbars. ## Customisation Everything the component layer decides reads a `--cct-*` property declared once on `body`, so you can retune it from your own CSS without patching the package: ```css body { /* A serif reading face, the way long-form prose is often set. */ --cct-prose: Georgia, "Songti SC", serif; plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.description: Declare an enterprise world, derive the agent's tools and permissions from it, and enforce them. A platform on DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepWork

> An enterprise agent has to know what a project is, who owns it, which customer it belongs
> to, and **what it is allowed to touch**. DeepWork is where an enterprise writes that down —
> and where an agent's tools and permissions are derived from it, and enforced.
>
> It is deliberately not part of an agent. The world it describes belongs to the enterprise, so
> the second agent, the third, and the one after that read the same one.

DeepWork is a platform built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). DSH ships a complete agent harness; DeepWork adds the one thing it does not ship — the
enterprise's own world, and the rules for acting in it. A plugin, not a fork, and a new domain
costs YAML rather than code.

## The whole project, as one line

Every part of this repository is one step of the same journey: a **world is declared**, an
**agent is equipped** from it, and what that agent does is **governed** on the way out.

```
   the enterprise's world                       what the agent gets
   ──────────────────────                       ────────────────────
①  declared    objects, relations, states,  →   a domain is data: `schema.yaml` and the
               who may write what                instances beside it

②  derived     read tools, the write tool,  →   a capability is declared, not coded —
               declared actions and queries      nothing in TypeScript to add or remove

③  authorised  `written_by` per type,       →   the host's own file and shell tools are
               roles per deployment              covered too; no roles means read-only

④  gated       states, the moves between    →   a move needing a second pair of eyes is
               them, and what each needs         refused without a verdict from somebody
                                                 other than the person making the move

⑤  recorded    the audit trail and write    →   every attempt, refusals included; field
               provenance                        names and never field values

⑥  checked     `npm run validate`           →   a declaration that did not take effect is
                                                 a failure, not a silence
```

Read it top to bottom and this repository is one thing. Read the sections below out of order
and it is a list of mechanisms.

The same line as a picture:

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph assembly["assembly"]
    prof["a profile: which plugins, which roles, which domain, which mode — changing the deployment changes only this layer"]
  end

  subgraph data["a domain — data, not code"]
    schema["schema.yaml — objects · relations · functions · states and transitions · who may write · actions · queries · situation · skill"]
    inst["the instances beside it"]
  end

  subgraph dw["DeepWork — a plugin, not a fork"]
    eng["the engine — reads the domain, builds the graph, derives the edges"]
    der["derivation — the read tools and query modes, the write tool, declared actions, the lifecycle's requirements"]
    gov["governance — the guard mounted globally in front of every call, permissions derived from written_by, review checked against provenance, an audit of field names and never field values"]
    inj["injection — the rules the situation marks, in the prompt and in the catalogue"]
    cap["a capability — a second plugin, declaring what its tools touch"]
  end

  subgraph hosted["the host — DeepSeek Harness"]
    loop["the agent loop · the tool registry · the skill and prompt registries · the session"]
    own["its own file and shell tools"]
  end

  prof --> dw
  schema --> eng
  inst --> eng
  eng --> der
  eng --> gov
  eng --> inj
  der -->|"the tool surface an agent is given"| loop
  inj -->|"the rules block, and the catalogue"| loop
  gov -->|"judges each call before it runs"| loop
  cap -->|"declares, so it is judged too"| gov
  gov -->|"or the host's own tools are the way around it"| own
  loop -->|"a write that was allowed"| wrote["the instance file, and one structured audit entry"]
  gov --> refused["a refusal, and one structured audit entry naming the rule that refused"]
```

Two places in that picture answer questions people expect one place to answer, so they are worth
naming. The guard is the door: before any tool runs, may this call touch this path at all. The write
path is the desk: may this content be written, by this caller, in this state. A capability's own
tools stop at the door; this plugin's write tool passes the door unjudged and is settled at the desk,
because nothing declares `ontology_write` and it is not in the built-in table — so its authority
lives inside the tool rather than in the mounted guard.

[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) is the same route written out — the layers, one write end to end, and the limits named; and the [same document in Chinese](docs/architecture.zh.md) is there for a reader who works in Chinese.

## Who this is for

Anyone putting an agent into a real business system. A forward-deployed engineer standing up
the first use case; a platform team that has to answer "what is this agent allowed to touch,
and who approved it"; the team that inherits it six months later.

## If you only look at one thing

`packages/ontology/examples/engagement` is the whole line at small scale: four stages, three of
them gated on a signature scoped to that stage, one declared action, one relation.

```sh
corepack pnpm install            # once, right after cloning — nothing else is needed
npm run validate                  # is it sound? exit 0 or a list of what did not take effect
node packages/ontology/scripts/show-derivation.ts packages/ontology/examples/engagement
```

The second command prints what came out of the declaration — and note what it prints with no
roles configured: three read tools, no write tool, and no actions derived, because an
unconfigured deployment is a read-only one.

Then `packages/ontology/src/examples.test.ts` runs it for real — a stage cannot be entered
without its signature, a signature for one stage does not open the next, and the role that
makes a move cannot sign for it. Those three sentences are the project, and they are a test
rather than a paragraph.

## The gap this fills

DSH ships a complete agent harness — loop, tools, skills, workflows, plan mode, approval,
subagents, sandboxing. What it does not ship is any notion of *the enterprise world* the
agent is working in. A general agent sees `document_001`, `project_782`, `user_23891`. An
enterprise agent needs to know what a project is, who owns it, which customer it belongs
to, and what it is allowed to touch.

That gap is semantic, not mechanical. This project fills it, and nothing else.

There is a third layer between the model and the harness, and this project is it. A model
reasons; a harness executes; neither knows what the enterprise *is*. That layer has to be
**declared**, and that word is doing the work. A context assembled per request out of whatever a
search surfaced is a guess about relevance — a good guess, and still a guess, and different on
Tuesday. A context declared as objects, relations and rules is a fact the enterprise can be asked
about, diffed, and held to, and the same question asked twice answers the same way.

It also has to distinguish what somebody vouched for from what merely got recorded. A layer that
cannot tell a rule a person signed off on from a note an agent wrote yesterday has made its own
trustworthiness a second thing nobody can check — so that distinction is a lifecycle here, and
only the vouched-for half ever reaches an agent.

```
DSH provides                    DeepWork adds
──────────────                  ──────────────
agent loop                      ontology    entities, relations, declared queries
tools                           governance  written_by, file_location, required_fields
skills                          injection   the vouched-for rules, marked for the situation in hand
                                audit       every write attempt, refusals included
workflow
plan mode
human review
sandbox
```

## The claim

**A domain author writes YAML. The agent gets tools. No

plugins.description: Model-controlled context blocks for DeepSeek Harness PTC mode
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-block-ptc

**English | [中文](README.zh.md)**

[![CI](https://github.com/mengwEX/dsh-block-ptc/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/mengwEX/dsh-block-ptc/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-block-ptc.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-block-ptc)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Blackboard blocks for **PTC mode** in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

A *block* is a blackboard region. Every program the model runs is tagged with a
block id, and when the block's work is finished the model hands in a summary
**it writes itself** — which then replaces that block's messages in the model's
own context. The original messages stay in the append-only session log, so the
human transcript keeps everything and replay stays deterministic.

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 or newer**; no upper version bound
- Community plugin maintained by [mengwEX](https://github.com/mengwEX)
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — the plugin imports nothing but `node:crypto`
- License: **MIT**

## Table of contents

- [Why](#why)
- [Context and cache comparison](#context-and-cache-comparison)
- [How it works](#how-it-works)
- [Install](#install)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Reference](#reference)
- [Design notes](#design-notes)
- [Verification](#verification)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Known limits](#known-limits)
- [Development](#development)
- [License](#license)

## Why

Automatic compaction condenses history when token pressure builds, and it
decides what to condense by size. It has no idea that the last forty messages
were one finished sub-task and the next ten are a new one.

This plugin lets the model draw that line itself: open a block, work inside it,
and close it with a handover summary — so the context it keeps is the one it
chose to keep. The summary costs no extra model request, because the model is
already generating when it closes the block.

## Context and cache comparison

![Illustrative comparison of input context and modeled cache hits for the same synthetic conversation](docs/assets/context-comparison.en.png)

**Mechanism illustration, not an API benchmark.** Both panels replay the same
synthetic four-task workload with assigned token weights. Full bar = input
context; blue = modeled cache hits, orange = modeled cache misses. Cached tokens
still occupy the context window.

After a block closes, the next request carries a summary in place of its
completed work. Replacing history can also invalidate the cached suffix:
**smaller context does not guarantee a higher cache-hit rate or a lower bill**.
The closing in-flight assistant/tool pair and all user messages remain. The
baseline here has not reached its built-in automatic compaction threshold.

See the [data, assumptions and reproduction steps](docs/context-comparison/README.md).
The real API fields needed for a measured version are documented there; the
plugin's `tokensFreed` is not a provider cache-hit measurement.

## How it works

The model's whole surface is two callables:

```
block_run_code({ id, description, code })     the only tool it may call directly
await tools.block_summary({ id, summary })    callable from inside a program
```

1. `block_run_code` runs the program through the built-in PTC `run_code`
   transport (nested dispatch), so program semantics, the `tools.*` SDK,
   sub-call logging, sandbox, timeouts and result rendering are the built-in
   ones. On top of that it records that this step belongs to block `id`.
   The first call with a new id opens the block; later calls continue it.
2. While a block is open, every message the model produces belongs to it.
3. `tools.block_summary({ id, summary })` closes it. The plugin replaces the
   first eligible contiguous span of completed messages with **one** summary
   at the start of that span. System/user messages and in-flight tool pairs
   remain; messages outside the replaced span also remain.
4. A node that belongs to several blocks is only replaced once every one of
   those blocks has been summarized.

What the human sees afterwards: the transcript still shows every original
turn (the log is append-only); the model's next request shows the summary
instead. In the Web UI the summary renders as a compaction checkpoint node.

## Install

Requirements: DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2` and its bundled runtime, with
Cordis `>=4.0.4`. Neither peer range has an upper version bound. The plugin
is a profile **bundle**: installing it adds one row to `dsh.profile.bundles`
and one new agent preset, `block-ptc`. It does not modify the shipped `ptc`
preset.

The version ranges allow newer hosts to load the plugin; they are not a record
of completed compatibility checks. Earlier live verification used DSH
`0.2.0-rc.2`; the current browser changes and newer hosts still await live
acceptance. DSH's plugin loader includes prereleases when evaluating its peer
ranges. The plugin checks the required tool/prompt methods before mounting and
the session methods before summarizing, and reports missing capabilities.
Method presence does not verify event semantics, preset configuration or browser
rendering; these still need validation when the host changes.

### From npm (recommended)

Find **dsh-block-ptc** in the Harness Plugin Manager and install it, or ask an
agent with the Plugin Manager tool enabled to install the bundle:

```
plugin_manager  install_bundle  dsh-block-ptc
```

The package is published on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-block-ptc).
Restart the application after installation and select the **Block PTC** preset.

### From a local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mengwEX/dsh-block-ptc.git
```

Install the absolute checkout path through the Plugin Manager:

```
plugin_manager  install_bundle  /absolute/path/to/dsh-block-ptc
```

Both methods use pnpm in the target profile. The local form installs a `link:`
dependency for development. Versioned source archives are also available under
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mengwEX/dsh-block-ptc/releases).

### Manual install (equivalent, if you prefer files)

In `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-block-ptc": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-block-ptc" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-block-ptc"] } }
}
```

then run pnpm in that directory.

### After installing

1. The preset appears in the session preset picker as **Block PTC**.
2. **Restart the application once.** The loader keeps a plugin module per
   resolved URL, and installing a bundle changes the composition; a running
   host keeps the old module generation until it restarts.
3. Start a session with the **Block PTC** preset.

### Uninstall

```
plugin_manager  remove_bundle  dsh-block-ptc
```

then restart. `plugin_manager set_bundle dsh-block-ptc enabled=false` disables
it without removing the package.

## Quick start

Say what you want done, then let it close the block when it finishes:

> Read the parser module, explain how the tokenizer works, then close the block
> and continue with the lexer.

You should see:

- the model calling `block_run_code` for everything it runs;
- a closing call to `block_summary` whose return value is
  `{"replaced": 3, "tokensFreed": 346}` — how many messages were replaced and
  the estimated token count of the replaced messages (before counting the new summary);
- the summary node `[block:<id>] …` sitting where those messages were.

If a tool call is refused with *"In block mode only `block_run_code` may be
called directly"*, that is the preset's guard working: in this mode every other
tool is reached from inside a program, exactly like PTC mode.

## Reference

### Tool `block_run_code`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Block id, a short stable slug such as `auth-refactor`. Everything this program does belongs to this block. |
| `description` | string | yes | One line stating the block's goal. Kept as the block's durable intent and used as the summary's header. |
| `code` |

plugins.description: Open-source, local-first envelope messaging for DeepSeek Harness: a TypeScript node, human-first inbox, explainable collaborator discovery, and bounded LAN recovery.
plugins.readme_text:
# Linko

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Linko is open-source, local-first envelope messaging for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It helps agents find the right collaborator, exchange scoped context, and continue a task under explicit human-controlled policies.

Linko is an early runnable MVP. The repository remains specification-driven: product boundaries, state transitions, delivery recovery, privacy rules, and architecture decisions are written beside the runtime.

## Why Linko

LAN messaging and approval panels are useful building blocks. Linko adds the part that becomes more useful with a person's own evidence and context:

- Each person and Agent can keep a subjective set of capability claims; later releases may attach signatures without creating a global reputation score.
- A task query can produce a local recommendation with evidence and an explanation.
- Context is shared by scope and purpose instead of being broadcast as a complete private history.
- A person can answer an inbound request, ask their Agent to draft a reply, or delegate a bounded response policy.
- Every delivery is a small envelope with a human-readable cover, machine-readable semantics, and an optional local body or safe surface.
- The experimental first group profile is capped at 500 member principals, with group delivery and message-layer E2EE as separate milestones.

## Project status

The MVP runs a SQLite-backed node and a human-first envelope inbox. It supports an explicit two-node HTTPS pairing profile with a durable outbox, pinned certificates, bearer authentication, retry-safe command IDs, and REST recovery. The local node also exposes an advisory loopback WebSocket for live UI hints; paired WSS delivery remains a later milestone. The replaceable TypeScript DSH companion bridge now provides `ask`, `inbox`, `inspect`, `draft`, `approve`, and `reply` adapters over the local API. Message signatures and E2EE remain later milestones; this is not a 20,000-node capacity claim.

- Product scope: [English](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.zh.md)
- Architecture: [English](docs/architecture.md) · [中文](docs/architecture.zh.md)
- State and storage: [English](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.zh.md)
- Review record: [English](docs/review.md) · [中文](docs/review.zh.md)
- Roadmap: [English](ROADMAP.md) · [中文](ROADMAP.zh.md)
- Decisions: [English](docs/decisions/README.md) · [中文](docs/decisions/README.zh.md)
- Local node MVP: [English](packages/node/README.md) · [中文](packages/node/README.zh.md)
- DSH companion bridge: [English](packages/bridge/README.md) · [中文](packages/bridge/README.zh.md)
- Envelope inbox UI: [English](packages/web/DESIGN.md) · [中文](packages/web/DESIGN.zh.md)

## Design direction

The first physical store is one SQLite database behind one TypeScript node. Immutable event content is durable; delivery attempts, read state, approvals, and notifications are local operational state. REST cursor synchronization and the SQLite outbox remain the canonical recovery path. The approved [2026 transport decision](docs/decisions/0010-wss-live-session-and-recovery.md) selects WSS as the online live session; its implementation remains pending. A graph can be materialized later as a view over claims; a graph database is not required.

The network uses ordinary IP and authenticated TCP/TLS connections, with explicit pairing. mDNS/DNS-SD is an optional discovery hint only; it does not grant trust or carry message bodies. Linko adds no application-layer router or payload flooding, and requires no Linko-specific router or switch feature. WebTransport/QUIC remain deferred experiments alongside DHT, Merkle synchronization, full-mesh sockets, blockchain consensus, and Rust/WASM; each needs a measured reason and a fallback test.

## DeepSeek Harness fit

Linko is intended to be a community plugin and companion protocol for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. It follows the Harness model that capabilities are composable plugins, while keeping the Linko protocol independently usable by other agents and clients.

## Contributing

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the repository guidance in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Early contributions are most useful as design review, threat modeling, interoperability experiments, and small protocol fixtures.

## Topics

The repository is indexed with dsh, dsh-plugin, deepseek-harness, agent-collaboration, local-first, lan-messaging, envelope-messaging, human-in-the-loop, sqlite, typescript, and pnpm.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: AI 输出信任边界：检查代码有没有直接执行 AI 输出（eval/shell/SQL/路径）。
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust)


**关键词**：AI 输出 · AI 安全 · 提示注入 · 提示词注入 · 大模型安全 · 任意代码执行 · LLM 安全 · 大模型
**Keywords**: AI output trust · prompt injection · LLM security · code execution · OWASP LLM
**AI 输出信任边界** —— 检查代码有没有直接执行 AI 输出。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 agent 里有这么一行：

```js
eval(aiResponse);
```

想法是「让模型生成一小段脚本，我执行它」。

**但 AI 输出是不可信输入** —— 它可能被提示注入控制，也可能自己发挥。
你等于把**任意代码执行权交给了一个概率模型**。

OWASP 把这单列为 **LLM05 Improper Output Handling**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 严重 | `eval(aiResponse)` / `new Function(...)` |
| 🔴 严重 | AI 输出拼进 `exec` / `spawn` |
| 🟠 高 | AI 输出拼进 SQL |
| 🟠 高 | 文件路径来自 AI 输出（路径穿越）|

## 它不会误报「只是调了模型」

变量识别用**精确命名**，不是「看到 `.content` 就报」。

**这段不报**（调了模型，但当成不可信输入处理）：
```js
const raw = result.choices[0].message.content;
const parsed = safeJsonParse(raw);
if (!schema.validate(parsed)) throw new Error('invalid');
```

**这段报**：
```js
eval(aiResponse);
```

## 正确的做法

```
AI 输出 → 结构化解析 → Schema 校验 → 白名单分支
        → 参数化查询
        → 路径规范化 + 断言在允许根目录内
```

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-ai-output-trust --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-ai-output-trust --list-rules    # 列出规则和依据
dsh-ai-output-trust --html r.html
```

![dsh-ai-output-trust 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/report.png)

![dsh-ai-output-trust 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/demo.png)

![dsh-ai-output-trust 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/rules.png)

## 边界

- **只查四种明确的高危用法**（eval / shell / SQL / 路径）。其它「间接信任」不在范围。
- **靠变量命名识别** —— 建议统一命名（`ai*` / `llm*` / `model*`），否则会漏。
- **不做数据流分析**，只看调用点附近。
- 与 [dsh-ci-guard](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) 分工：那个查 GitHub Actions 脚本注入，这个查运行时。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

# dsh-auto-maximize
DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：启动自动最大化主窗口（等同于手动点击最大化按钮）

适用于 DSH desktop profile，以及所有基于 Electron / 系统窗口运行 DSH 的场景。

**仓库**：Gitee（主）<https://gitee.com/FideFei/dsh-auto-maximize> ｜ GitHub（镜像）<https://github.com/FideFeiPlane/dsh-auto-maximize>

## 原理与平台支持

插件是 host-only 插件，随桌面版 host 进程在应用启动时加载。host 进程是 Node 子进程
（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，由 Electron 主进程拉起），拿不到 `BrowserWindow`，
因此按平台调用系统级「最大化」能力，全部**尽力而为、失败只记日志、绝不 crash host**：

| 平台 | 策略 | 依赖 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Windows | Win32 `ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_MAXIMIZE)` | **pwsh 7** → **Windows PowerShell 5.1** 自动回退 | pwsh 7 缺失时自动用 5.1（Windows 自带）；无需额外安装。PowerShell 按 PATH 解析、不写死安装路径；5.1 的 `Add-Type` 内置编译器，脚本两版通用 |
| macOS | 把窗口设为主屏可视区大小（`NSScreen.visibleFrame`，即「向窗口发送最大化指令」）；该调用失败时再点击绿色 `AXZoomButton` 作为补救 | `osascript`（系统自带） | 需要「辅助功能/Accessibility」授权，未授权会给出指引日志；`processName` 可覆盖应用名 |
| Linux | `wmctrl` → `xdotool` 设置 `_NET_WM_STATE_MAXIMIZED` | 通常**未预装**，需自行安装 | 尽力而为；两者都缺则跳过 |

窗口定位（Windows）：优先取 host 进程的父进程 PID（即 Electron 主进程）且可执行文件路径一致，
失败则按可执行文件路径扫描所有带主窗口的进程。macOS/Linux 按窗口标题/进程名匹配
（默认取运行中的可执行文件名，可用 `processName` 覆盖）。

**为什么不能直接调 `BrowserWindow.maximize()`**：host 进程是纯 Node（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，
已实测 `require('electron')` 失败），插件只能拿到系统级窗口句柄——因此「自动最大化」被实现为
「等价于用户点击一次最大化按钮」的系统调用，而非 Electron API 调用。

## 安装

### 方式一：通过插件市场 / npm（推荐，发布后可用）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-auto-maximize
```

### 方式二：本地工程安装（开发调试）

在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）：

```jsonc
// package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-auto-maximize": "file:./plugins/dsh-auto-maximize" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* 追加 */ "dsh-auto-maximize" ] } }
}
```

然后 `pnpm install`，重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖 `auto-maximize` 行即可：

```yaml
- id: auto-maximize
  config:
    enabled: false        # 禁用
    timeoutMs: 30000      # 等待窗口出现的超时（毫秒，默认 20000）
    processName: 'DeepSeek Harness'   # macOS/Linux 定位窗口用的进程名
```

配置项：

| 配置 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | `false` 时整个插件不做事 |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `20000` | 启动后持续寻找窗口的最长时间（毫秒） |
| `processName` | string | 可执行文件名 | macOS/Linux 定位窗口用的进程/窗口标题名 |
| `logFile` | boolean \| string | `~/.dsh/auto-maximize.log` | 诊断日志：`false` 关闭文件日志；字符串指定自定义路径；删除文件即清空 |

## macOS：需要「辅助功能」授权

macOS 出于安全限制，用 `osascript`（System Events）控制其他 App 的窗口必须先获得
**「辅助功能 / Accessibility」**授权。

> ⚠️ **注意事项：指令形式同样需要授权。** 插件把窗口直接设为 `set position/size`（「向窗口发送
> 最大化指令」）还是点击 `AXZoomButton`，**两种方式都走同一套 macOS Accessibility API，都需要
> 辅助功能授权**。原因：插件跑在 host（外部 Node 进程）里，要挪动另一个进程的窗口只能走该 API，
> 系统的闸门拦的是 API 本身、不是进程身份——哪怕 `osascript` 是 DSH 自己的子进程也一样（TCC 会把
> 授权追溯归属到 DSH 应用，所以勾选 DeepSeek Harness 即可覆盖它，但这并不豁免授权）。唯一能免授权的
> 路径是让 DSH 在自身进程内最大化自己的窗口（如启动参数 / host→main 的 IPC 调
> `BrowserWindow.maximize()`），那需要 DSH 本体提供通道，插件作为外部方做不到。**因此请保留授权**。

插件未获授权时会在 host 日志输出指引（关键字 `dsh-auto-maximize`），按以下步骤授权后重启即可：

1. 打开 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能**；
2. 勾选 **DeepSeek Harness**（以及承载/启动它的终端或启动器，如有）；
3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness（授权对已运行的进程不生效）。

仍无效时，可用 `processName` 指定实际的进程名——打包后应用显示名可能与可执行文件名不同。

**诊断日志**：从 1.1.2 起，插件每一步都会追加写入 `~/.dsh/auto-maximize.log`
（Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\auto-maximize.log`）。排查「没生效」时直接看这个文件，能立刻看到
`osascript` 返回的 `perm:`（缺授权）/ `nowindow:`（没找到窗口）/ `maximized-bounds`（成功）等结果。
不需要日志时用 `logFile: false` 关闭，或直接删除该文件清空。每次启动会把上一次日志轮转为
`auto-maximize.log.old`，只保留本次与最近一次，文件不会无限累积。

> 对比：**Windows 端不需要任何额外权限**——`ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_MAXIMIZE)` 是直接 Win32 API
> 调用（非模拟点击），对同一用户的窗口无需提权。

## 卸载

从 profile 的 `package.json` 两处（`dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles`）移除
`dsh-auto-maximize`，再执行 `pnpm install`，重启应用。

## 开发

```sh
npm install   # 无第三方运行时依赖；仅 dev 需要（测试用 node:test）
npm test      # 冒烟测试：模块加载 / 禁用分支 / 效果注册
npm pack      # 生成可发布的 tarball（先跑测试）
```

## 发布到 npm

```sh
npm login                                   # 首次
npm publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
```

发布后即可在 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 插件市场的
「申请收录插件 ↗」入口提交收录（指向 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
的 `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml`，见 [提交指南](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/contributing.md)）。

## 已知限制

- 仅在桌面版（desktop profile）有意义；web profile 无窗口，插件会安静跳过。
- 只启动时执行一次，不会干预会话中手动调整的窗口状态。
- 多实例/多窗口：Windows 上优先通过「host 的父进程 PID + 可执行路径」精确定位所属实例的
  主窗口，多个 DSH 实例互不干扰；父进程匹配失败时才按可执行路径扫描，此时多开场景可能
  命中另一个实例的窗口。macOS/Linux 取「最前端/首个匹配」窗口，多开时建议用 `processName` 区分。
- 失败只写 host 日志（关键字 `dsh-auto-maximize`），不影响应用运行。

## Roadmap（未实现，欢迎 PR）

- **设置 UI 开关**：把 `enabled` 接进「设置 → 通用设置」。当前为 host-only 插件，只能通过
  `cordis.patch.yml` 配置；做成界面开关需要 client-plugin 侧的设置面板扩展。
- **去掉 PowerShell 依赖**：Windows 端可改用 FFI（koffi 等）直调 `user32.dll`，免起子进程；
  但会引入原生二进制，破坏「零运行时依赖」，故暂未采用（现状：PS 5.1 为 Windows 自带）。
- **正式图标**：`assets/icon.svg` 为占位设计（最大化双框图形），欢迎替换为正式图标。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © FideFei

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-control

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Every machine already runs dsh. Make this one window the front end for all of them.**

Chat with the dsh instances on your other machines, natively from your local sidebar.
Remote sessions stream back token by token; the remote uses its own model credentials,
tools and sandbox. Zero changes on the remote. Zero dependencies. One-line install.

![dsh-control in action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/hero.png)

*Two dsh windows answering the same question. The left window shows a session auto-named
`控制端·<local title>` (①) — that naming only happens on the machine the plugin drives. The right
window shows the workspace `cn-dsh2` the plugin created (②) and the model route set to the
environment name (③).*

> 🎬 A 15-second capture (one-click connect → streaming reply) is being recorded.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add github:6mt/dsh-control
```

Use the profile you already run (usually `web` or `desktop`). No build step, no native
modules, no dependencies — the plugin is plain JavaScript and installs as-is.

<details>
<summary>GitHub slow or blocked? Install from the release tarball instead</summary>

Download [dsh-control-0.1.1.tgz](https://github.com/6mt/dsh-control/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-control-0.1.1.tgz)
and run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add ./dsh-control-0.1.1.tgz
```
</details>

After installing, **fully quit and reopen dsh** (⌘Q). A「远程 dsh 环境」panel appears
in the right sidebar.

> An npm package (`dsh-control`) is prepared and can be published later; the GitHub
> command above is the current install path.

## Versions & updating

- **What you get**: `github:6mt/dsh-control` installs the newest commit of `main` and
  **pins it in your profile's lockfile** — it does not silently follow later commits.
- **Update**: `dsh plugin --profile <your profile> update dsh-control`
  *(pnpm re-resolves the git ref and pulls the new code)*
- **Pin a version**: `github:6mt/dsh-control#v0.1.0` (tag) or `github:6mt/dsh-control#<commit>`
- Changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## How is this different from dsh-remote / dsh-remote-ssh?

![How the two approaches differ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/compare.svg)

| | Remote-workspace plugins (dsh-remote, …) | **dsh-control** |
|---|---|---|
| The remote machine is a | **file system** (SFTP tool set) | **dsh that is already running there** |
| Sessions live | local session + remote directory | **remote sessions, native in your sidebar** |
| Credentials & tools | configured locally, SSH config duplicated | the remote's own — nothing copied |
| Remote needs | only SSH | dsh installed (≥0.2.0-rc.2) with its web instance running |
| Changes on the remote | some deploy dsh for you | **zero** (read-only probing + the remote's own API) |

The two **coexist** (tested side by side): no dsh on the remote → use dsh-remote;
dsh already there → use dsh-control.

## What it does

![The remote dsh environments panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/panel.png)

*The「远程 dsh 环境」panel: type `user@host` and connect — the row then reports its state and
whether the environment already has its workspace.*

- **One-click connect** — type `user@host`; the plugin probes the remote dsh, fetches
  its access token and opens an encrypted channel (~5 s)
- **Automatic workspace** — each environment gets a same-named local workspace; any
  session created inside it automatically becomes a remote session
- **True streaming** — remote replies flow in token by token, not dumped at the end
- **Paired naming** — remote sessions are named `控制端·<local title>`, so both sides match
- **Visible & self-healing** — remote sessions are marked in the sidebar; disconnects
  are reported honestly and repaired by one click

## Security

**What it does on your machine**: one state file
(`$DSH_HOME/dsh-control/state.json`, mode 0600, holds the remote access tokens) and an
on-demand SSH tunnel process.
**What it never does**: no installs or writes on the remote, no lifecycle management of
the remote dsh, never reads your other local credentials, tokens never enter logs.
When passwordless SSH is not set up it shows the exact one-line fix — passwords are
never stored. Details in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Known limitations

- The remote must already run dsh with its web instance (otherwise use a
  remote-workspace plugin)
- Connects over SSH (passwordless or configured key; a direct no-SSH mode is on the roadmap)
- Sidebar markers and the streaming feel are verified by eye per release
- Cancelling a remote turn is implemented but marked experimental

## Development

```sh
node --check lib/*.js
for t in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$t"; done   # 52 checks: unit / contract / structural invariants
scripts/verify-boot-selfheal.sh                # boot self-heal (needs a local dsh runtime)
```

## License

MIT © 6mt

plugins.description: Unified rail for the DSH sidebar: sort the top panels and the bottom actions as one list. / DSH 左侧栏统一排序插件：顶部面板与底部动作混排成同一条序列。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-railist

**English** | [中文](#中文)

---

## English

Manage the whole DSH left column as one list: reorder rows across the panel list and the footer action row, rename them, change their icons, hide them, and fold them into Groups. Everything is configured in a new Settings tab and applies immediately.

> A fork of [dsh-panellist](https://github.com/qwq1999/dsh-panellist). Upstream manages the panel list alone; this fork extends it to a single sequence spanning two seats.

---

## Features

- **One sequence across seats** — the panel list and the footer action row are sorted as a single list, so a row can be dragged from one into the other.
- **Reorder by drag** — drag any row to a new position; the rail follows the list live.
- **Rename and re-icon** — give any row your own label and pick its icon from a built-in set.
- **Show / hide** — take a row off the rail without uninstalling its plugin.
- **Groups** — fold several rows into one Group row with a flyout menu; ungroup at any time.
- **Appearance override** — adjust the rail's own look from the Settings tab.
- **Config file's full path** — shown in Settings so you can back it up or edit it.

The Settings row itself always stays last and cannot be dragged, and every change is written to disk only when you press Save.

## Screenshots

| Settings → Panel list | Appearance override | A Group menu on the rail |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| ![Settings → Panel list](docs/images/settings-panel-list.png) | ![Appearance override](docs/images/settings-appearance.png) | ![A Group menu on the rail](docs/images/rail-group-menu.png) |

## Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-railist
```

Then restart DSH. To remove it:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-railist
```

## Compatibility

| Requirement | Version |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| Profile | `web` |
| Platform | Windows / macOS / Linux desktop |

## Configuration

Your settings live in `~/.dsh/railist.json`. The full path is also shown in the Settings tab. If a row's plugin is missing or disabled, the row is kept in the file and marked as missing rather than being deleted.

## License

MIT

---

## 中文

把 DSH 左侧栏当成一整条列表来管理：跨「面板区」与「底部动作区」调整顺序、重命名、换图标、隐藏，以及把若干行折叠成分组。全部在设置页完成，改完立即生效。

> 本项目 fork 自 [dsh-panellist](https://github.com/qwq1999/dsh-panellist)。上游只管理面板区；本 fork 把它扩展成跨越两个区域的同一条序列。

---

## 功能

- **跨区域同一条序列** —— 面板区与底部动作区当成一条列表排序，所以一个行可以从一个区域拖进另一个区域。
- **拖动排序** —— 把任意行拖到新位置，左侧栏实时跟随。
- **重命名与换图标** —— 给任意行起自己的名字，并从内置图标集里挑图标。
- **显示 / 隐藏** —— 把某一行从左侧栏隐藏，而不必卸载它的插件。
- **分组** —— 把若干行折叠成一个分组行（带展开菜单），随时可以解组。
- **外观覆盖** —— 在设置页调整左侧栏自身的外观。
- **配置文件全路径** —— 设置页直接显示，方便你备份或手动编辑。

「设置」那一行固定在最下方、不可拖动；所有改动都要点保存才会写进磁盘。

## 效果图

| 设置 → 面板列表 | 外观覆盖 | 左侧栏上的分组菜单 |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| ![设置 → 面板列表](docs/images/settings-panel-list.png) | ![外观覆盖](docs/images/settings-appearance.png) | ![左侧栏上的分组菜单](docs/images/rail-group-menu.png) |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-railist
```

装完重启 DSH。卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-railist
```

## 兼容版本

| 要求 | 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| Profile | `web` |
| 平台 | Windows / macOS / Linux 桌面端 |

## 配置

配置存在 `~/.dsh/railist.json`，设置页里也会显示完整路径。如果某一行的插件被卸载或停用，这一行会保留在配置里并标记为「已缺失」，不会被自动删掉。

## 许可证

MIT
